## 1) Pipeline Purpose

This notebook combines the previous meta-analysis and differential abundance analysis into one reproducible pipeline.

- Phase A: Build alpha/beta effect-size tables across studies
- Phase B: Fit meta-meta models
- Phase C: Run within-study DAA (ALDEx2 + ANCOM)
- Phase D: Save all outputs to `results/`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## 2) Configuration

Use this section to turn phases on/off and control reproducibility.

```{r config}
set.seed(520)

run_meta_phase <- TRUE
run_daa_phase <- TRUE
run_metric_correlation <- TRUE

# Compute/plot toggles for fast reruns
run_phase_a_collect <- TRUE
run_phase_a_es <- TRUE

run_metric_correlation_models <- TRUE
run_metric_correlation_plots <- TRUE

run_meta_models <- TRUE
run_meta_plots <- TRUE

run_loo_models <- TRUE
run_loo_plots <- TRUE

run_daa_models <- TRUE
run_daa_plots <- TRUE

# Effect size threshold for ALDEx2 significance filtering (adjustable)
# This filters taxa based on both adjusted p-value AND effect size magnitude
aldex_effect_size_threshold <- 1.0  # Typical range: 0.5-2.0 (log-scale effect size)
# Interpretation:
#   0.5 = medium effect size (less stringent filtering)
#   1.0 = large effect size (moderate filtering) - DEFAULT
#   2.0 = very large effect size (stringent filtering)

# Set TRUE to process all studies in map; set FALSE to run only one study.
run_all_studies <- TRUE
study_single <- "Gubert et al. 2022"
```

```{r load-functions-and-data}
normalize_group <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      subgroup = case_when(
        is.na(experimental_treatment_raw) ~ NA_character_,
        experimental_treatment_raw == "Water-T0" ~ "control",
        Authors == "Velasco et al. 2021" & strain == "C57BL/6J" ~ "control",
        TRUE ~ experimental_treatment_raw
      ),
      group_general = case_when(
        is.na(subgroup) ~ NA_character_,
        grepl("control", subgroup, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "control",
        TRUE ~ "treatment"
      )
    )
}
```

## 5) Phase A — Alpha/Beta Effect-Size Data Assembly

This phase iterates studies and subgroups to compute alpha diversity metrics and beta dispersion summaries.

```{r phase-a-assemble}
collect_one_study <- function(phy, study_name, group_var) {
  sub <- subset_samples(phy, Authors == study_name)
  sub <- subset_samples(sub, !(tissue %in% c("skin", "nose", "ear")))
  sdf <- data.frame(sample_data(sub))

  if (!group_var %in% names(sdf)) {
    return(list(alpha = tibble(), beta = tibble(), sample_data = tibble()))
  }

  sdf <- normalize_group(sdf)
  sample_data(sub) <- sample_data(sdf)

  dat_alpha_local <- tibble()
  tb_all_local <- tibble()

  for (subgroup in unique(sdf[[group_var]])) {
    sub_sub <- subset_samples(sub, get(group_var) == subgroup)
    sub_sub <- subset_samples(sub_sub, !(tissue %in% c("skin", "nose", "ear")))

    if (nsamples(sub_sub) < 2) next

    raremin <- min(sample_sums(sub_sub))

    otu <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(otu_table(sub_sub)), "Row")
    rownames(otu) <- otu$Row
    otu$Row <- NULL

    otu.srs <- SRS(otu, Cmin = raremin)
    rownames(otu.srs) <- rownames(otu)
    otu.srs <- otu_table(as.matrix(otu.srs), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

    sub_srs <- merge_phyloseq(
      phyloseq(otu.srs, sample_data(sub_sub), tax_table(sub_sub), phy_tree(sub_sub))
    )

    PD_value <- tryCatch(
      picante::pd(samp = data.frame(t(data.frame(phyloseq::otu_table(sub_srs)))), tree = phy_tree(sub_srs))[, 1],
      error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nsamples(sub_srs))
    )

    sub_alpha <- data.frame(
      Observed = phyloseq::estimate_richness(sub_srs, measures = "Observed"),
      Chao1 = phyloseq::estimate_richness(sub_srs, measures = "Chao1"),
      Shannon = phyloseq::estimate_richness(sub_srs, measures = "Shannon"),
      Simpson = phyloseq::estimate_richness(sub_srs, measures = "Simpson"),
      PD = PD_value,
      Sex = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)$host_sex,
      subgroup = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)[[group_var]],
      group_general = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)$group_general,
      Authors = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)$Authors,
      Protocol = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)$Protocol,
      tissue = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)$tissue,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    sub_alpha$Evenness <- sub_alpha$Shannon / log(sub_alpha$Observed)
    dat_alpha_local <- bind_rows(dat_alpha_local, sub_alpha)

    sub_df <- data.frame(sample_data(sub_sub))
    group_general_val <- sub_df$group_general[which(!is.na(sub_df$group_general))[1]]
    if (length(group_general_val) == 0) group_general_val <- NA_character_

    n_male <- sum(sub_df$host_sex == "male")
    n_female <- sum(sub_df$host_sex == "female")
    if (n_male < 2 || n_female < 2) next

    dist_list <- list(
      unifrac_dist = phyloseq::distance(sub_sub, method = "unifrac", weighted = FALSE),
      wunifrac_dist = phyloseq::distance(sub_sub, method = "unifrac", weighted = TRUE),
      bray_dist = phyloseq::distance(sub_sub, method = "bray"),
      jac_dist = phyloseq::distance(sub_sub, method = "jaccard")
    )

    for (dist_name in names(dist_list)) {
      beta_disp <- betadisper(dist_list[[dist_name]], sub_df$host_sex)
      sd_dispersion <- tapply(beta_disp$distances, sub_df$host_sex, sd)

      tb <- tibble(
        Sex = rownames(beta_disp$group.distances),
        distance = as.numeric(beta_disp$group.distances),
        sd = as.numeric(sd_dispersion),
        metric = dist_name,
        Authors = study_name,
        subgroup = subgroup,
        group_general = group_general_val,
        n_male = n_male,
        n_female = n_female
      )

      tb_all_local <- bind_rows(tb_all_local, tb)
    }
  }

  list(alpha = dat_alpha_local, beta = tb_all_local, sample_data = sdf)
}

phase_a_cache_file <- here("results", "phase_a_collected.rds")

if (run_phase_a_collect) {
  collected <- purrr::pmap(study_group_map, ~collect_one_study(dat33, ..1, ..2))

  dat_alpha <- bind_rows(purrr::map(collected, "alpha"))
  tb_all <- bind_rows(purrr::map(collected, "beta"))

  dat_alpha <- dat_alpha %>% filter(!tissue %in% c("skin", "nose", "ear"))

  saveRDS(
    list(dat_alpha = dat_alpha, tb_all = tb_all),
    phase_a_cache_file
  )
} else {
  if (!file.exists(phase_a_cache_file)) {
    stop("Phase A cache not found at results/phase_a_collected.rds. Set run_phase_a_collect <- TRUE once.")
  }
  phase_a_cache <- readRDS(phase_a_cache_file)
  dat_alpha <- phase_a_cache$dat_alpha
  tb_all <- phase_a_cache$tb_all
}
```

```{r phase-a-es-tables}
if (run_meta_phase && run_phase_a_es) {
  dat_alpha_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
    dat_alpha,
    cols = c(Observed, Chao1, Shannon, Simpson, PD, Evenness),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

  dat_alpha_group <- dat_alpha_long %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c("Authors", "subgroup", "group_general", "Sex", "metric")))) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sex, values_from = c(mean, sd, n))

  alpha_es <- calculate_ES(dat_alpha_group, mod = c("Authors", "metric", "subgroup", "group_general")) %>%
    mutate(
      Protocol = str_extract(Authors, "^[^ ]+"),
      metric = str_replace(metric, "Observed", "Richness"),
      metric = str_replace(metric, "PD", "Faith's PD")
    )

  alpha_es[sapply(alpha_es, is.numeric)] <- lapply(
    alpha_es[sapply(alpha_es, is.numeric)],
    function(x) replace(x, is.infinite(x), NA)
  )

  alpha_es$metric <- factor(alpha_es$metric, levels = c("Richness", "Chao1", "Evenness", "Shannon", "Simpson", "Faith's PD"))
  alpha_es$stats <- factor(alpha_es$stats, levels = c("lnRR", "lnCVR", "lnVR"))
  alpha_es$obs <- seq_len(nrow(alpha_es))

  tb_all_long <- tb_all %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sex, values_from = c(distance, sd)) %>%
    rename(
      mean_male = distance_male,
      mean_female = distance_female,
      sd_male = sd_male,
      sd_female = sd_female
    ) %>%
    filter(n_male != 0, n_female != 0)

  beta_es <- lnRR2(
    tb_all_long[c("Authors", "metric", "subgroup", "group_general")],
    tb_all_long$mean_male,
    tb_all_long$sd_male,
    tb_all_long$n_male,
    tb_all_long$mean_female,
    tb_all_long$sd_female,
    tb_all_long$n_female
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Protocol = str_extract(Authors, "^[^ ]+"),
      metric = str_replace(metric, "wunifrac_dist", "Weighted Unifrac"),
      metric = str_replace(metric, "unifrac_dist", "Unweighted Unifrac"),
      metric = str_replace(metric, "bray_dist", "Bray-Curtis"),
      metric = str_replace(metric, "jac_dist", "Jaccard"),
      obs = row_number()
    )

  beta_es$metric <- factor(beta_es$metric, levels = c("Jaccard", "Bray-Curtis", "Weighted Unifrac", "Unweighted Unifrac"))

  write.csv(alpha_es, here("results", "alpha_es.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(beta_es, here("results", "beta_es_lnRR.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
} else if (run_meta_phase) {
  alpha_es_file <- here("results", "alpha_es.csv")
  beta_es_file <- here("results", "beta_es_lnRR.csv")

  if (!file.exists(alpha_es_file) || !file.exists(beta_es_file)) {
    stop("Missing alpha/beta effect-size CSV files in results/. Set run_phase_a_es <- TRUE once.")
  }

  alpha_es <- read.csv(alpha_es_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  beta_es <- read.csv(beta_es_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  alpha_es$metric <- factor(alpha_es$metric, levels = c("Richness", "Chao1", "Evenness", "Shannon", "Simpson", "Faith's PD"))
  alpha_es$stats <- factor(alpha_es$stats, levels = c("lnRR", "lnCVR", "lnVR"))
  if (!"obs" %in% names(alpha_es)) alpha_es$obs <- seq_len(nrow(alpha_es))

  beta_es$metric <- factor(beta_es$metric, levels = c("Jaccard", "Bray-Curtis", "Weighted Unifrac", "Unweighted Unifrac"))
  if (!"obs" %in% names(beta_es)) beta_es$obs <- seq_len(nrow(beta_es))
}
```

## 6) Phase B — Correlation Across Diversity Metrics

This phase tests how strongly alpha metrics agree with each other and how strongly beta distance metrics agree with each other.
These correlations can help explain why significance appears in some metrics but not others.

```{r phase-b-metric-correlations}
if (run_metric_correlation) {
  run_metric_correlation_models <- isTRUE(run_metric_correlation_models)
  run_metric_correlation_plots <- isTRUE(run_metric_correlation_plots)

  alpha_means_file <- here("results", "alpha_study_means.csv")
  beta_means_file <- here("results", "beta_study_means.csv")
  alpha_cor_file <- here("results", "alpha_metric_correlations.csv")
  beta_cor_file <- here("results", "beta_metric_correlations.csv")

  if (run_metric_correlation_models) {
    if ("Chao1.Chao1" %in% names(dat_alpha) && !"Chao1" %in% names(dat_alpha)) {
      dat_alpha$Chao1 <- dat_alpha$Chao1.Chao1
    }

    # ── Alpha: aggregate to study-level means for scatter labels ──────────────
    alpha_study_means <- dat_alpha %>%
      group_by(Authors, subgroup) %>%
      summarise(
        Richness     = mean(Observed, na.rm = TRUE),
        Chao1        = mean(Chao1,    na.rm = TRUE),
        Evenness     = mean(Evenness, na.rm = TRUE),
        Shannon      = mean(Shannon,  na.rm = TRUE),
        Simpson      = mean(Simpson,  na.rm = TRUE),
        `Faith's PD` = mean(PD,       na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(study_label = paste(Authors, subgroup, sep = "\n"))

    alpha_metrics <- c("Richness", "Chao1", "Evenness", "Shannon", "Simpson", "Faith's PD")

    alpha_cor_mat <- cor(
      alpha_study_means[, alpha_metrics],
      method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
    )
    alpha_cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(alpha_cor_mat)) %>%
      rename(metric_1 = Var1, metric_2 = Var2, rho = Freq)

    write.csv(alpha_study_means, alpha_means_file, row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(alpha_cor_df, alpha_cor_file, row.names = FALSE)

    # ── Beta: aggregate to study-level means for scatter labels ───────────────
    beta_study_means <- tb_all %>%
      group_by(Authors, subgroup, metric) %>%
      summarise(distance = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = distance) %>%
      rename(
        `Unweighted UniFrac` = unifrac_dist,
        `Weighted UniFrac`   = wunifrac_dist,
        `Bray-Curtis`        = bray_dist,
        Jaccard              = jac_dist
      ) %>%
      mutate(study_label = paste(Authors, subgroup, sep = "\n"))

    beta_metrics <- c("Unweighted UniFrac", "Weighted UniFrac", "Bray-Curtis", "Jaccard")

    beta_cor_mat <- cor(
      beta_study_means[, beta_metrics],
      method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
    )
    beta_cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(beta_cor_mat)) %>%
      rename(metric_1 = Var1, metric_2 = Var2, rho = Freq)

    write.csv(beta_study_means, beta_means_file, row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_cor_df, beta_cor_file, row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    required_files <- c(alpha_means_file, beta_means_file, alpha_cor_file, beta_cor_file)
    missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
    if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Missing Phase B correlation input files: ",
          paste(basename(missing_files), collapse = ", "),
          ". Set run_metric_correlation_models <- TRUE once."
        )
      )
    }

    alpha_study_means <- read.csv(alpha_means_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_study_means <- read.csv(beta_means_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    alpha_cor_df <- read.csv(alpha_cor_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_cor_df <- read.csv(beta_cor_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  if (run_metric_correlation_plots) {
    # ── Helper: scatter plot for one metric pair with Cook's-D outlier labeling ──
    scatter_with_outliers <- function(df, x_col, y_col,
                                      label_col = "study_label",
                                      n_label = 3, rho = NULL) {
      x   <- df[[x_col]]
      y   <- df[[y_col]]
      lbl <- df[[label_col]]
      keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
      x <- x[keep]; y <- y[keep]; lbl <- lbl[keep]
      n    <- length(x)
      fit  <- lm(y ~ x)
      cd   <- cooks.distance(fit)
      thr   <- sort(cd, decreasing = TRUE)[min(n_label, n)]
      flags <- cd >= thr & cd > 0
      pdat  <- data.frame(x = x, y = y, label = lbl, outlier = flags,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      sub_txt <- if (!is.null(rho)) sprintf("Spearman rho = %.2f", rho) else NULL
      ggplot(pdat, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#2166AC",
                    fill = "#AED6F1", alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.7) +
        geom_point(aes(color = outlier), size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
        ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
          data          = subset(pdat, outlier),
          aes(label     = label),
          size          = 2.4,
          max.overlaps  = 20,
          segment.color = "grey55",
          box.padding   = 0.4,
          color         = "#B2182B"
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c(`FALSE` = "grey40", `TRUE` = "#B2182B"),
          guide  = "none"
        ) +
        labs(x = x_col, y = y_col, subtitle = sub_txt) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
        theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40"))
    }

    get_rho <- function(cor_df, m1, m2) {
      val <- cor_df %>%
        filter((metric_1 == m1 & metric_2 == m2) | (metric_1 == m2 & metric_2 == m1)) %>%
        slice_head(n = 1) %>%
        pull(rho)
      if (length(val) == 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(val)
    }

    alpha_metrics <- c("Richness", "Chao1", "Evenness", "Shannon", "Simpson", "Faith's PD")
    beta_metrics <- c("Unweighted UniFrac", "Weighted UniFrac", "Bray-Curtis", "Jaccard")

    alpha_pairs <- combn(alpha_metrics, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    alpha_scatter_list <- lapply(alpha_pairs, function(pr) {
      rho_val <- get_rho(alpha_cor_df, pr[1], pr[2])
      scatter_with_outliers(
        df        = alpha_study_means,
        x_col     = pr[1],
        y_col     = pr[2],
        label_col = "study_label",
        n_label   = 3,
        rho       = rho_val
      )
    })

    p_alpha_scatter <- patchwork::wrap_plots(alpha_scatter_list, ncol = 5) +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(
        title    = "Pairwise Alpha Diversity Metric Scatter Plots",
        subtitle = paste(
          "Each point = study-level mean; red = top-3 influential studies (Cook's D);",
          "blue line = OLS fit with 95% CI"
        )
      )

    ggsave(
      here("results", "alpha_metric_scatter_pairs.png"),
      p_alpha_scatter,
      width = 18, height = 10, dpi = 300
    )

    beta_pairs <- combn(beta_metrics, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    beta_scatter_list <- lapply(beta_pairs, function(pr) {
      rho_val <- get_rho(beta_cor_df, pr[1], pr[2])
      scatter_with_outliers(
        df        = beta_study_means,
        x_col     = pr[1],
        y_col     = pr[2],
        label_col = "study_label",
        n_label   = 3,
        rho       = rho_val
      )
    })

    p_beta_scatter <- patchwork::wrap_plots(beta_scatter_list, ncol = 3) +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(
        title    = "Pairwise Beta Diversity Metric Scatter Plots",
        subtitle = paste(
          "Each point = study-group mean; red = top-3 influential studies (Cook's D);",
          "blue line = OLS fit with 95% CI"
        )
      )

    ggsave(
      here("results", "beta_metric_scatter_pairs.png"),
      p_beta_scatter,
      width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300
    )

    p_alpha_scatter
    p_beta_scatter
  } else {
    message("Phase B correlation plot generation skipped (run_metric_correlation_plots = FALSE).")
  }
}
```

## 7) Phase C — Meta-Meta Models

This phase estimates summary effects per diversity metric.

```{r phase-b-meta-models}
if (run_meta_phase) {
  alpha_stats <- unique(as.character(alpha_es$stats))
  run_meta_models <- isTRUE(run_meta_models)
  run_meta_plots <- isTRUE(run_meta_plots)
  meta_fit_file <- here("results", "meta_model_fits.rds")

  fit_meta_model_best <- function(data_in, mod_formula) {
    fit_homo <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi,
        vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~1 | obs),
        mod = mod_formula,
        data = data_in,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    fit_hetero <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi,
        vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~metric | obs),
        mod = mod_formula,
        data = data_in,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    aic_homo <- if (is.null(fit_homo)) NA_real_ else tryCatch(as.numeric(AIC(fit_homo)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    aic_hetero <- if (is.null(fit_hetero)) NA_real_ else tryCatch(as.numeric(AIC(fit_hetero)), error = function(e) NA_real_)

    if (is.null(fit_homo) && is.null(fit_hetero)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    use_hetero <- !is.null(fit_hetero) && (is.null(fit_homo) || (!is.na(aic_hetero) && (is.na(aic_homo) || aic_hetero < aic_homo)))

    list(
      fit = if (use_hetero) fit_hetero else fit_homo,
      best_random = if (use_hetero) "heteroscedastic_metric_obs" else "homoscedastic_obs",
      random_obs = if (use_hetero) ~metric | obs else ~1 | obs,
      aic_homo = aic_homo,
      aic_hetero = aic_hetero
    )
  }

  # Extract per-metric coefficient table from an rma.mv fit as a flat tibble.
  extract_model_coef <- function(fit_obj, domain_label, stats_label) {
    b_mat <- as.matrix(fit_obj$b)
    term_names <- rownames(b_mat)
    if (is.null(term_names)) term_names <- paste0("V", seq_len(nrow(b_mat)))
    tibble(
      domain    = domain_label,
      stats     = stats_label,
      term      = term_names,
      metric    = gsub("^metric", "", term_names),
      estimate  = as.numeric(b_mat[, 1]),
      se        = as.numeric(fit_obj$se),
      ci_lb     = as.numeric(fit_obj$ci.lb),
      ci_ub     = as.numeric(fit_obj$ci.ub),
      pval      = as.numeric(fit_obj$pval),
      tval      = as.numeric(fit_obj$zval)
    )
  }

  # Plot orchard with a single panel, using different shapes/colours per level of by_col.
  # Internally fits ~metric * by_col - 1 for the visualization; falls back to a plain
  # orchard (no by) if the interaction model fails or by_col has < 2 levels.
  plot_orchard_by_moderator <- function(data_in, by_col, xlab_text, output_file) {
    dat_viz <- data_in %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[by_col]]), is.finite(yi), is.finite(vi), vi > 0)

    fit_base_best <- fit_meta_model_best(dat_viz, ~metric - 1)
    if (is.null(fit_base_best)) return(NULL)

    if (dplyr::n_distinct(dat_viz[[by_col]]) < 2) {
      p <- orchaRd::orchard_plot(fit_base_best$fit, mod = "metric",
                                  group = "Authors", xlab = xlab_text)
      ggsave(here("results", output_file), p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
      return(p)
    }

    mod_formula_interact <- as.formula(paste0("~metric * ", by_col, " - 1"))
    fit_viz <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi, vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, fit_base_best$random_obs),
        mod = mod_formula_interact,
        data = dat_viz,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit_viz)) {
      p <- orchaRd::orchard_plot(fit_base_best$fit, mod = "metric",
                                  group = "Authors", xlab = xlab_text)
    } else {
      p <- orchaRd::orchard_plot(fit_viz, mod = "metric", by = by_col,
                                  group = "Authors", xlab = xlab_text)
    }
    ggsave(here("results", output_file), p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
    p
  }

  run_interaction_lrt <- function(data_in, domain_label, stats_label) {
    dat_lrt <- data_in %>%
      filter(
        is.finite(yi),
        is.finite(vi),
        vi > 0,
        !is.na(metric),
        !is.na(group_general),
        !is.na(Authors)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        metric = factor(metric),
        group_general = factor(group_general)
      )

    base_row <- tibble(
      domain = domain_label,
      stats = stats_label,
      n_rows = nrow(dat_lrt),
      n_studies = dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$Authors),
      n_metrics = dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$metric),
      n_groups = dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$group_general),
      lrt = NA_real_,
      pval = NA_real_,
      interaction_sig = NA,
      status = "not_tested"
    )

    if (nrow(dat_lrt) < 8 || dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$metric) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$group_general) < 2) {
      return(base_row %>% mutate(status = "insufficient_data"))
    }

    fit_with_inter_best <- fit_meta_model_best(dat_lrt, ~metric * group_general - 1)
    if (is.null(fit_with_inter_best)) {
      return(base_row %>% mutate(status = "model_fit_failed"))
    }

    fit_no_inter <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi,
        vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, fit_with_inter_best$random_obs),
        mod = ~metric + group_general - 1,
        data = dat_lrt,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    fit_with_inter <- fit_with_inter_best$fit

    if (is.null(fit_no_inter) || is.null(fit_with_inter)) {
      return(base_row %>% mutate(status = "model_fit_failed"))
    }

    lrt_obj <- tryCatch(anova(fit_no_inter, fit_with_inter), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(lrt_obj)) {
      return(base_row %>% mutate(status = "lrt_failed"))
    }

    lrt_df <- as.data.frame(lrt_obj)
    lrt_val <- if ("LRT" %in% names(lrt_df)) as.numeric(lrt_df$LRT[nrow(lrt_df)]) else NA_real_
    pval_val <- if ("pval" %in% names(lrt_df)) as.numeric(lrt_df$pval[nrow(lrt_df)]) else NA_real_

    base_row %>%
      mutate(
        random_structure = fit_with_inter_best$best_random,
        aic_homo = fit_with_inter_best$aic_homo,
        aic_hetero = fit_with_inter_best$aic_hetero,
        lrt = lrt_val,
        pval = pval_val,
        interaction_sig = ifelse(is.na(pval_val), NA, pval_val < 0.05),
        status = "ok"
      )
  }

  if (run_meta_models) {
    alpha_fit_list <- list()

    alpha_model_results <- purrr::map_dfr(alpha_stats, function(stat_name) {
      alpha_data_stat <- alpha_es %>% filter(stats == stat_name)
      if (nrow(alpha_data_stat) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(alpha_data_stat$metric) < 2) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      fit_alpha_best <- fit_meta_model_best(alpha_data_stat, ~metric - 1)
      if (is.null(fit_alpha_best)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      fit_alpha_stat <- fit_alpha_best$fit
      alpha_fit_list[[stat_name]] <<- fit_alpha_stat

      if (run_meta_plots) {
        p_alpha_meta_stat <- plot_orchard_by_moderator(
          data_in = alpha_data_stat,
          by_col = "group_general",
          xlab_text = stat_name,
          output_file = paste0("alpha_meta_orchard_", stat_name, ".png")
        )
      }

      extract_model_coef(fit_alpha_stat, "alpha", stat_name) %>%
        mutate(
          random_structure = fit_alpha_best$best_random,
          aic_homo         = fit_alpha_best$aic_homo,
          aic_hetero       = fit_alpha_best$aic_hetero
        )
    })

    fit_beta_best <- fit_meta_model_best(beta_es, ~metric - 1)
    if (is.null(fit_beta_best)) {
      stop("Phase C beta meta model failed under both homoscedastic and heteroscedastic random-effect structures.")
    }

    fit_beta_lnrr <- fit_beta_best$fit

    beta_model_results <- extract_model_coef(fit_beta_lnrr, "beta", "lnRR") %>%
      mutate(
        random_structure = fit_beta_best$best_random,
        aic_homo         = fit_beta_best$aic_homo,
        aic_hetero       = fit_beta_best$aic_hetero
      )
    if (run_meta_plots) {
      p_beta_meta <- plot_orchard_by_moderator(
        data_in = beta_es,
        by_col = "group_general",
        xlab_text = "lnRR",
        output_file = "beta_meta_orchard_lnRR.png"
      )
    }

    alpha_interaction_lrt <- purrr::map_dfr(alpha_stats, function(stat_name) {
      run_interaction_lrt(
        data_in = alpha_es %>% filter(stats == stat_name),
        domain_label = "alpha",
        stats_label = stat_name
      )
    })

    beta_interaction_lrt <- run_interaction_lrt(
      data_in = beta_es,
      domain_label = "beta",
      stats_label = "lnRR"
    )

    meta_interaction_lrt <- bind_rows(alpha_interaction_lrt, beta_interaction_lrt)

    write.csv(alpha_model_results, here("results", "alpha_meta_model_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_model_results, here("results", "beta_meta_model_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(meta_interaction_lrt, here("results", "meta_metric_treatment_interaction_lrt.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    saveRDS(
      list(alpha_fits = alpha_fit_list, beta_fit = fit_beta_lnrr),
      meta_fit_file
    )
  } else {
    alpha_model_file <- here("results", "alpha_meta_model_results.csv")
    beta_model_file <- here("results", "beta_meta_model_results.csv")
    lrt_file <- here("results", "meta_metric_treatment_interaction_lrt.csv")

    if (!file.exists(alpha_model_file) || !file.exists(beta_model_file) || !file.exists(lrt_file)) {
      stop("Missing Phase C meta CSV outputs. Set run_meta_models <- TRUE once.")
    }

    alpha_model_results <- read.csv(alpha_model_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_model_results <- read.csv(beta_model_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    meta_interaction_lrt <- read.csv(lrt_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    if (run_meta_plots) {
      if (!file.exists(meta_fit_file)) {
        stop("Missing results/meta_model_fits.rds for plot-only meta reruns. Set run_meta_models <- TRUE once.")
      }

      meta_fits <- readRDS(meta_fit_file)
      alpha_fit_list <- meta_fits$alpha_fits
      fit_beta_lnrr <- meta_fits$beta_fit

      for (stat_name in names(alpha_fit_list)) {
        plot_orchard_by_moderator(
          data_in = alpha_es %>% dplyr::filter(stats == stat_name),
          by_col = "group_general",
          xlab_text = stat_name,
          output_file = paste0("alpha_meta_orchard_", stat_name, ".png")
        )
      }

      p_beta_meta <- plot_orchard_by_moderator(
        data_in = beta_es,
        by_col = "group_general",
        xlab_text = "lnRR",
        output_file = "beta_meta_orchard_lnRR.png"
      )
    }
  }

  if (run_meta_plots && exists("p_beta_meta")) {
    p_beta_meta
  } else if (!run_meta_plots) {
    message("Phase C meta plot generation skipped (run_meta_plots = FALSE).")
  }
}
```

### Phase C.Treat — Meta-Meta Models for Treatment vs Control Effect Sizes

This section runs the same meta-meta framework as Phase C, but using treatment-vs-control effect-size tables (`alpha_es_treat`, `beta_es_treat`) and testing `Sex` as the moderator factor in interaction models.

```{r phase-c-treat-meta-models}
if (run_meta_phase) {
  run_meta_models <- isTRUE(run_meta_models)
  run_meta_plots <- isTRUE(run_meta_plots)

  alpha_treat_file <- here("results", "alpha_es_treatment_control.csv")
  beta_treat_file <- here("results", "beta_es_lnRR_treatment.csv")

  if (!exists("alpha_es_treat")) {
    if (!file.exists(alpha_treat_file)) {
      stop("Missing treatment-control alpha effect sizes. Provide alpha_es_treat in memory or results/alpha_es_treatment_control.csv.")
    }
    alpha_es_treat <- read.csv(alpha_treat_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  if (!exists("beta_es_treat")) {
    if (!file.exists(beta_treat_file)) {
      stop("Missing treatment-control beta effect sizes. Provide beta_es_treat in memory or results/beta_es_lnRR_treatment.csv.")
    }
    beta_es_treat <- read.csv(beta_treat_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  alpha_es_treat$metric <- factor(alpha_es_treat$metric, levels = c("Richness", "Chao1", "Evenness", "Shannon", "Simpson", "Faith's PD"))
  alpha_es_treat$stats <- factor(alpha_es_treat$stats, levels = c("lnRR", "lnCVR", "lnVR"))
  if (!"obs" %in% names(alpha_es_treat)) alpha_es_treat$obs <- seq_len(nrow(alpha_es_treat))

  beta_es_treat$metric <- factor(beta_es_treat$metric, levels = c("Jaccard", "Bray-Curtis", "Weighted Unifrac", "Unweighted Unifrac"))
  if (!"obs" %in% names(beta_es_treat)) beta_es_treat$obs <- seq_len(nrow(beta_es_treat))

  alpha_treat_stats <- unique(as.character(alpha_es_treat$stats))

  meta_fit_treat_file <- here("results", "meta_model_fits_treatment_control.rds")
  alpha_model_treat_file <- here("results", "alpha_meta_model_results_treatment_control.csv")
  beta_model_treat_file <- here("results", "beta_meta_model_results_treatment_control.csv")
  lrt_treat_file <- here("results", "meta_metric_treatment_interaction_lrt_treatment_control.csv")

  fit_meta_model_best_treat <- function(data_in, mod_formula) {
    fit_homo <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi,
        vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~1 | obs),
        mod = mod_formula,
        data = data_in,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    fit_hetero <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi,
        vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~metric | obs),
        mod = mod_formula,
        data = data_in,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    aic_homo <- if (is.null(fit_homo)) NA_real_ else tryCatch(as.numeric(AIC(fit_homo)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    aic_hetero <- if (is.null(fit_hetero)) NA_real_ else tryCatch(as.numeric(AIC(fit_hetero)), error = function(e) NA_real_)

    if (is.null(fit_homo) && is.null(fit_hetero)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    use_hetero <- !is.null(fit_hetero) && (is.null(fit_homo) || (!is.na(aic_hetero) && (is.na(aic_homo) || aic_hetero < aic_homo)))

    list(
      fit = if (use_hetero) fit_hetero else fit_homo,
      best_random = if (use_hetero) "heteroscedastic_metric_obs" else "homoscedastic_obs",
      random_obs = if (use_hetero) ~metric | obs else ~1 | obs,
      aic_homo = aic_homo,
      aic_hetero = aic_hetero
    )
  }

  # Plot a single orchard panel; means per metric are split by Sex using different
  # shapes/colours. Fits ~metric * Sex - 1 for visualization (falls back to plain
  # orchard if the interaction model fails or fewer than 2 sex levels are present).
  plot_orchard_by_sex <- function(data_in, xlab_text, title_text, output_file) {
    if (!"Sex" %in% names(data_in)) return(NULL)

    dat_viz <- data_in %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sex), is.finite(yi), is.finite(vi), vi > 0)

    fit_base_best <- fit_meta_model_best_treat(dat_viz, ~metric - 1)
    if (is.null(fit_base_best)) return(NULL)

    if (dplyr::n_distinct(dat_viz$Sex) < 2) {
      p_out <- orchaRd::orchard_plot(fit_base_best$fit, mod = "metric",
                                     group = "Authors", xlab = xlab_text) +
        ggtitle(title_text)
      ggsave(here("results", output_file), p_out, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
      return(p_out)
    }

    fit_viz <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi, vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, fit_base_best$random_obs),
        mod = ~metric * Sex - 1,
        data = dat_viz,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit_viz)) {
      p_out <- orchaRd::orchard_plot(fit_base_best$fit, mod = "metric",
                                     group = "Authors", xlab = xlab_text) +
        ggtitle(title_text)
    } else {
      p_out <- orchaRd::orchard_plot(fit_viz, mod = "metric", by = "Sex",
                                     group = "Authors", xlab = xlab_text) +
        ggtitle(title_text)
    }
    ggsave(here("results", output_file), p_out, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
    p_out
  }

  run_interaction_lrt_by_factor <- function(data_in, domain_label, stats_label, factor_col = "Sex") {
    base_row <- tibble(
      domain = domain_label,
      stats = stats_label,
      moderator = factor_col,
      n_rows = 0L,
      n_studies = 0L,
      n_metrics = 0L,
      n_levels = 0L,
      lrt = NA_real_,
      pval = NA_real_,
      interaction_sig = NA,
      status = "not_tested"
    )

    if (!factor_col %in% names(data_in)) {
      return(base_row %>% mutate(status = "missing_moderator"))
    }

    dat_lrt <- data_in %>%
      filter(
        is.finite(yi),
        is.finite(vi),
        vi > 0,
        !is.na(metric),
        !is.na(Authors),
        !is.na(.data[[factor_col]])
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        metric = factor(metric),
        moderator = factor(.data[[factor_col]])
      )

    base_row <- base_row %>%
      mutate(
        n_rows = nrow(dat_lrt),
        n_studies = dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$Authors),
        n_metrics = dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$metric),
        n_levels = dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$moderator)
      )

    if (nrow(dat_lrt) < 8 || dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$metric) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(dat_lrt$moderator) < 2) {
      return(base_row %>% mutate(status = "insufficient_data"))
    }

    fit_with_inter_best <- fit_meta_model_best_treat(dat_lrt, ~metric * moderator - 1)
    if (is.null(fit_with_inter_best)) {
      return(base_row %>% mutate(status = "model_fit_failed"))
    }

    fit_no_inter <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi,
        vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, fit_with_inter_best$random_obs),
        mod = ~metric + moderator - 1,
        data = dat_lrt,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    fit_with_inter <- fit_with_inter_best$fit

    if (is.null(fit_no_inter) || is.null(fit_with_inter)) {
      return(base_row %>% mutate(status = "model_fit_failed"))
    }

    lrt_obj <- tryCatch(anova(fit_no_inter, fit_with_inter), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(lrt_obj)) {
      return(base_row %>% mutate(status = "lrt_failed"))
    }

    lrt_df <- as.data.frame(lrt_obj)
    lrt_val <- if ("LRT" %in% names(lrt_df)) as.numeric(lrt_df$LRT[nrow(lrt_df)]) else NA_real_
    pval_val <- if ("pval" %in% names(lrt_df)) as.numeric(lrt_df$pval[nrow(lrt_df)]) else NA_real_

    base_row %>%
      mutate(
        random_structure = fit_with_inter_best$best_random,
        aic_homo = fit_with_inter_best$aic_homo,
        aic_hetero = fit_with_inter_best$aic_hetero,
        lrt = lrt_val,
        pval = pval_val,
        interaction_sig = ifelse(is.na(pval_val), NA, pval_val < 0.05),
        status = "ok"
      )
  }

  if (run_meta_models) {
    alpha_treat_fit_list <- list()

    alpha_model_results_treat <- purrr::map_dfr(alpha_treat_stats, function(stat_name) {
      alpha_data_stat <- alpha_es_treat %>% filter(stats == stat_name)
      if (nrow(alpha_data_stat) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(alpha_data_stat$metric) < 2) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      fit_alpha_treat_best <- fit_meta_model_best_treat(alpha_data_stat, ~metric - 1)
      if (is.null(fit_alpha_treat_best)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      fit_alpha_treat_stat <- fit_alpha_treat_best$fit
      alpha_treat_fit_list[[stat_name]] <<- fit_alpha_treat_stat

      extract_model_coef(fit_alpha_treat_stat, "alpha_treatment_control", stat_name) %>%
        mutate(
          random_structure = fit_alpha_treat_best$best_random,
          aic_homo         = fit_alpha_treat_best$aic_homo,
          aic_hetero       = fit_alpha_treat_best$aic_hetero
        )
    })

    fit_beta_treat_best <- fit_meta_model_best_treat(beta_es_treat, ~metric - 1)
    if (is.null(fit_beta_treat_best)) {
      stop("Phase C.Treat beta meta model failed under both homoscedastic and heteroscedastic random-effect structures.")
    }

    fit_beta_treat_lnrr <- fit_beta_treat_best$fit

    beta_model_results_treat <- extract_model_coef(fit_beta_treat_lnrr, "beta_treatment_control", "lnRR") %>%
      mutate(
        random_structure = fit_beta_treat_best$best_random,
        aic_homo         = fit_beta_treat_best$aic_homo,
        aic_hetero       = fit_beta_treat_best$aic_hetero
      )

    alpha_interaction_lrt_treat <- purrr::map_dfr(alpha_treat_stats, function(stat_name) {
      run_interaction_lrt_by_factor(
        data_in = alpha_es_treat %>% filter(stats == stat_name),
        domain_label = "alpha_treatment_control",
        stats_label = stat_name,
        factor_col = "Sex"
      )
    })

    beta_interaction_lrt_treat <- run_interaction_lrt_by_factor(
      data_in = beta_es_treat,
      domain_label = "beta_treatment_control",
      stats_label = "lnRR",
      factor_col = "Sex"
    )

    meta_interaction_lrt_treat <- bind_rows(alpha_interaction_lrt_treat, beta_interaction_lrt_treat)

    write.csv(alpha_model_results_treat, alpha_model_treat_file, row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_model_results_treat, beta_model_treat_file, row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(meta_interaction_lrt_treat, lrt_treat_file, row.names = FALSE)

    saveRDS(
      list(alpha_fits = alpha_treat_fit_list, beta_fit = fit_beta_treat_lnrr),
      meta_fit_treat_file
    )
  } else {
    if (!file.exists(alpha_model_treat_file) || !file.exists(beta_model_treat_file) || !file.exists(lrt_treat_file)) {
      stop("Missing treatment-control meta CSV outputs. Set run_meta_models <- TRUE once.")
    }

    alpha_model_results_treat <- read.csv(alpha_model_treat_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_model_results_treat <- read.csv(beta_model_treat_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    meta_interaction_lrt_treat <- read.csv(lrt_treat_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  if (run_meta_plots) {
    alpha_treat_plot_list <- purrr::map(alpha_treat_stats, function(stat_name) {
      alpha_data_stat <- alpha_es_treat %>% filter(stats == stat_name)
      plot_orchard_by_sex(
        data_in = alpha_data_stat,
        xlab_text = paste0(stat_name, " (Treatment vs Control)"),
        title_text = paste0("Alpha Orchard by Sex (", stat_name, ")"),
        output_file = paste0("alpha_meta_orchard_treatment_control_by_sex_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", stat_name), ".png")
      )
    }) %>% purrr::compact()

    p_beta_treat_meta <- plot_orchard_by_sex(
      data_in = beta_es_treat,
      xlab_text = "lnRR (Treatment vs Control)",
      title_text = "Beta Orchard by Sex (Treatment vs Control)",
      output_file = "beta_meta_orchard_lnRR_treatment_control_by_sex.png"
    )

    if (length(alpha_treat_plot_list) > 0) {
      alpha_treat_plot_list[[1]]
    } else {
      p_beta_treat_meta
    }
  } else if (!run_meta_plots) {
    message("Phase C.Treat meta plot generation skipped (run_meta_plots = FALSE).")
  }
}
```

### Phase C.1 — Leave-One-Study-Out Sensitivity Analysis

This sensitivity analysis re-fits each meta model after excluding one study at a time.
If one study is strongly driving a metric's summary effect, the coefficient shift will be large in these leave-one-out results.

```{r phase-c1-leave-one-out}

if (run_meta_phase && (run_loo_models || run_loo_plots)) {
  run_loo_models <- isTRUE(run_loo_models)
  run_loo_plots <- isTRUE(run_loo_plots)

  beta_model_data <- beta_es

  extract_coef_table <- function(fit_obj, left_out_label) {
    beta_mat <- as.matrix(fit_obj$b)
    term_names <- rownames(beta_mat)
    if (is.null(term_names)) {
      term_names <- paste0("term_", seq_len(nrow(beta_mat)))
    }

    tibble(
      left_out = left_out_label,
      term = term_names,
      estimate = as.numeric(beta_mat[, 1]),
      se = as.numeric(fit_obj$se),
      ci_lb = as.numeric(fit_obj$ci.lb),
      ci_ub = as.numeric(fit_obj$ci.ub),
      pval = as.numeric(fit_obj$pval)
    )
  }

  run_leave_one_out <- function(data_in, model_label) {
    full_fit <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi,
        vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~1 | obs),
        mod = ~metric - 1,
        data = data_in,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(full_fit)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    full_tbl <- extract_coef_table(full_fit, left_out_label = "none")

    loo_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(unique(data_in$Authors), function(study_drop) {
      data_loo <- data_in %>% filter(Authors != study_drop)

      if (nrow(data_loo) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(data_loo$metric) < 2) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      fit_loo <- tryCatch(
        rma.mv(
          yi,
          vi,
          random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~1 | obs),
          mod = ~metric - 1,
          data = data_loo,
          test = "t",
          method = "REML",
          sparse = TRUE
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(fit_loo)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      extract_coef_table(fit_loo, left_out_label = study_drop)
    })

    combined_tbl <- bind_rows(full_tbl, loo_tbl) %>%
      mutate(model = model_label)

    delta_tbl <- combined_tbl %>%
      filter(left_out != "none") %>%
      left_join(
        full_tbl %>% dplyr::select(
          term,
          full_estimate = estimate,
          full_pval     = pval,
          full_ci_lb    = ci_lb,
          full_ci_ub    = ci_ub
        ),
        by = "term"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        delta_from_full = estimate - full_estimate,
        full_sig       = full_pval < 0.05,
        loo_sig        = pval < 0.05,
        direction_flip = sign(estimate) != sign(full_estimate),
        sig_change     = full_sig != loo_sig,
        robustness     = dplyr::case_when(
          direction_flip &  sig_change ~ "Flip + sig. change",
          direction_flip & !sig_change ~ "Direction flip only",
         !direction_flip &  sig_change ~ "Sig. change only",
          TRUE                         ~ "Stable"
        )
      )

    list(full = full_tbl, all = combined_tbl, delta = delta_tbl)
  }

  clean_file_tag <- function(x) {
    x %>%
      tolower() %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
  }

  plot_loo_by_metric <- function(df_in, title_text, subtitle_text) {
    pdat <- df_in %>%
      mutate(
        left_out = forcats::fct_reorder(left_out, abs(delta_from_full)),
        term = stringr::str_remove(term, "^metric")
      )

    ggplot(pdat, aes(x = delta_from_full, y = left_out)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = delta_from_full, y = left_out, yend = left_out), alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_point(aes(color = delta_from_full > 0), size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#B2182B", `FALSE` = "#2166AC"), guide = "none") +
      facet_wrap(~term, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(
        title = title_text,
        subtitle = subtitle_text,
        x = "Delta from full-model estimate",
        y = "Left-out study"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9))
  }

  robustness_levels <- c("Stable", "Sig. change only", "Direction flip only", "Flip + sig. change")
  robustness_colors <- c(
    "Stable"              = "#4DAF4A",
    "Sig. change only"    = "#FF7F00",
    "Direction flip only" = "#984EA3",
    "Flip + sig. change"  = "#E41A1C"
  )

  if (run_loo_models) {
    alpha_stats <- unique(as.character(alpha_es$stats))

    alpha_loo_list <- purrr::map(alpha_stats, function(stat_name) {
      alpha_model_data <- alpha_es %>% filter(stats == stat_name)

      if (nrow(alpha_model_data) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(alpha_model_data$metric) < 2) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      out <- run_leave_one_out(alpha_model_data, model_label = paste0("alpha_", stat_name))
      if (is.null(out)) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      list(
        all = out$all %>% mutate(stats = stat_name, .before = 1),
        delta = out$delta %>% mutate(stats = stat_name, .before = 1)
      )
    })

    alpha_loo_list <- purrr::compact(alpha_loo_list)
    beta_loo <- run_leave_one_out(beta_model_data, model_label = "beta_lnRR")

    alpha_loo_all <- bind_rows(purrr::map(alpha_loo_list, "all"))
    alpha_loo_delta <- bind_rows(purrr::map(alpha_loo_list, "delta"))
    beta_loo_all <- beta_loo$all
    beta_loo_delta <- beta_loo$delta

    write.csv(alpha_loo_all, here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(alpha_loo_delta, here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_delta.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_loo_all, here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_loo_delta, here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_delta.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    alpha_influential <- alpha_loo_delta %>%
      group_by(stats, term) %>%
      slice_max(order_by = abs(delta_from_full), n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup()

    beta_influential <- beta_loo_delta %>%
      group_by(term) %>%
      slice_max(order_by = abs(delta_from_full), n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup()

    alpha_robustness_summary <- alpha_loo_delta %>%
      mutate(
        term       = stringr::str_remove(term, "^metric"),
        robustness = factor(robustness, levels = robustness_levels)
      ) %>%
      count(stats, term, robustness, name = "n_studies") %>%
      tidyr::complete(stats, term, robustness, fill = list(n_studies = 0L))

    beta_robustness_summary <- beta_loo_delta %>%
      mutate(
        term       = stringr::str_remove(term, "^metric"),
        robustness = factor(robustness, levels = robustness_levels)
      ) %>%
      count(term, robustness, name = "n_studies") %>%
      tidyr::complete(term, robustness, fill = list(n_studies = 0L))

    write.csv(alpha_robustness_summary, here("results", "alpha_meta_loo_robustness.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_robustness_summary,  here("results", "beta_meta_loo_robustness.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(alpha_influential, here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_influential, here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    req_loo_files <- c(
      here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out.csv"),
      here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_delta.csv"),
      here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out.csv"),
      here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_delta.csv"),
      here("results", "alpha_meta_loo_robustness.csv"),
      here("results", "beta_meta_loo_robustness.csv"),
      here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential.csv"),
      here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential.csv")
    )

    missing_loo_files <- req_loo_files[!file.exists(req_loo_files)]
    if (length(missing_loo_files) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Missing Phase C.1 LOO files: ",
          paste(basename(missing_loo_files), collapse = ", "),
          ". Set run_loo_models <- TRUE once."
        )
      )
    }

    alpha_loo_all <- read.csv(here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    alpha_loo_delta <- read.csv(here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_delta.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_loo_all <- read.csv(here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_loo_delta <- read.csv(here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_delta.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    alpha_robustness_summary <- read.csv(here("results", "alpha_meta_loo_robustness.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_robustness_summary <- read.csv(here("results", "beta_meta_loo_robustness.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    alpha_influential <- read.csv(here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_influential <- read.csv(here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  if (run_loo_plots) {
    alpha_robustness_summary <- alpha_robustness_summary %>%
      mutate(robustness = factor(robustness, levels = robustness_levels))
    beta_robustness_summary <- beta_robustness_summary %>%
      mutate(robustness = factor(robustness, levels = robustness_levels))

    p_alpha_robustness <- alpha_robustness_summary %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = term, y = n_studies, fill = robustness)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = robustness_colors, name = "LOO outcome") +
      facet_wrap(~stats, ncol = 1) +
      labs(
        title    = "Alpha Diversity — LOO Robustness Summary",
        subtitle = "Number of studies whose removal changes direction or significance",
        x        = "Metric",
        y        = "Number of studies"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold")
      )

    p_beta_robustness <- beta_robustness_summary %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = term, y = n_studies, fill = robustness)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = robustness_colors, name = "LOO outcome") +
      labs(
        title    = "Beta Diversity (lnRR) — LOO Robustness Summary",
        subtitle = "Number of studies whose removal changes direction or significance",
        x        = "Metric",
        y        = "Number of studies"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

    ggsave(here("results", "meta_loo_robustness_alpha.png"), p_alpha_robustness,
           width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(here("results", "meta_loo_robustness_beta.png"),  p_beta_robustness,
           width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

    alpha_plot_index <- alpha_influential %>%
      group_by(stats) %>%
      group_split() %>%
      purrr::map_dfr(function(dsub) {
        stat_name <- unique(dsub$stats)

        p <- plot_loo_by_metric(
          dsub,
          title_text = paste("Alpha LOO Influence (", stat_name, ")", sep = ""),
          subtitle_text = paste("Effect size:", stat_name)
        )

        file_name <- paste0("meta_leave_one_out_influence_alpha_", clean_file_tag(stat_name), ".png")
        file_path <- here("results", file_name)
        n_terms <- dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$term)
        ggsave(file_path, p, width = 4 * n_terms, height = 6, dpi = 300)

        tibble(
          domain = "alpha",
          stats = stat_name,
          term = "all_terms",
          plot_file = paste0("results/", file_name)
        )
      })

    p_beta_loo <- plot_loo_by_metric(
      beta_influential,
      title_text = "Beta LOO Influence (lnRR)",
      subtitle_text = "Effect size: lnRR"
    )
    beta_file_name <- "meta_leave_one_out_influence_beta_lnrr.png"
    beta_file_path <- here("results", beta_file_name)
    beta_n_terms <- dplyr::n_distinct(beta_influential$term)
    ggsave(beta_file_path, p_beta_loo, width = 4 * beta_n_terms, height = 6, dpi = 300)

    beta_plot_index <- tibble(
      domain = "beta",
      stats = "lnRR",
      term = "all_terms",
      plot_file = paste0("results/", beta_file_name)
    )

    loo_plot_index <- bind_rows(alpha_plot_index, beta_plot_index)
    write.csv(loo_plot_index, here("results", "meta_leave_one_out_plot_index.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    loo_plot_index
  } else {
    message("Phase C.1 LOO plot generation skipped (run_loo_plots = FALSE).")
  }
}
```

### Phase C.Treat.1 — Leave-One-Study-Out Sensitivity (Treatment vs Control)

This sensitivity analysis re-fits treatment-vs-control meta models after excluding one study at a time.

```{r phase-c-treat1-leave-one-out}

if (run_meta_phase && (run_loo_models || run_loo_plots)) {
  run_loo_models <- isTRUE(run_loo_models)
  run_loo_plots <- isTRUE(run_loo_plots)

  alpha_treat_file <- here("results", "alpha_es_treatment_control.csv")
  beta_treat_file <- here("results", "beta_es_lnRR_treatment.csv")

  if (!exists("alpha_es_treat")) {
    if (!file.exists(alpha_treat_file)) {
      stop("Missing treatment-control alpha effect sizes. Provide alpha_es_treat in memory or results/alpha_es_treatment_control.csv.")
    }
    alpha_es_treat <- read.csv(alpha_treat_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  if (!exists("beta_es_treat")) {
    if (!file.exists(beta_treat_file)) {
      stop("Missing treatment-control beta effect sizes. Provide beta_es_treat in memory or results/beta_es_lnRR_treatment.csv.")
    }
    beta_es_treat <- read.csv(beta_treat_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  alpha_es_treat$metric <- factor(alpha_es_treat$metric, levels = c("Richness", "Chao1", "Evenness", "Shannon", "Simpson", "Faith's PD"))
  alpha_es_treat$stats <- factor(alpha_es_treat$stats, levels = c("lnRR", "lnCVR", "lnVR"))
  if (!"obs" %in% names(alpha_es_treat)) alpha_es_treat$obs <- seq_len(nrow(alpha_es_treat))

  beta_es_treat$metric <- factor(beta_es_treat$metric, levels = c("Jaccard", "Bray-Curtis", "Weighted Unifrac", "Unweighted Unifrac"))
  if (!"obs" %in% names(beta_es_treat)) beta_es_treat$obs <- seq_len(nrow(beta_es_treat))

  extract_coef_table_treat <- function(fit_obj, left_out_label) {
    beta_mat <- as.matrix(fit_obj$b)
    term_names <- rownames(beta_mat)
    if (is.null(term_names)) {
      term_names <- paste0("term_", seq_len(nrow(beta_mat)))
    }

    tibble(
      left_out = left_out_label,
      term = term_names,
      estimate = as.numeric(beta_mat[, 1]),
      se = as.numeric(fit_obj$se),
      ci_lb = as.numeric(fit_obj$ci.lb),
      ci_ub = as.numeric(fit_obj$ci.ub),
      pval = as.numeric(fit_obj$pval)
    )
  }

  run_leave_one_out_treat <- function(data_in, model_label) {
    full_fit <- tryCatch(
      rma.mv(
        yi,
        vi,
        random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~1 | obs),
        mod = ~metric - 1,
        data = data_in,
        test = "t",
        method = "REML",
        sparse = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(full_fit)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    full_tbl <- extract_coef_table_treat(full_fit, left_out_label = "none")

    loo_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(unique(data_in$Authors), function(study_drop) {
      data_loo <- data_in %>% filter(Authors != study_drop)

      if (nrow(data_loo) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(data_loo$metric) < 2) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      fit_loo <- tryCatch(
        rma.mv(
          yi,
          vi,
          random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~1 | obs),
          mod = ~metric - 1,
          data = data_loo,
          test = "t",
          method = "REML",
          sparse = TRUE
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(fit_loo)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      extract_coef_table_treat(fit_loo, left_out_label = study_drop)
    })

    combined_tbl <- bind_rows(full_tbl, loo_tbl) %>%
      mutate(model = model_label)

    delta_tbl <- combined_tbl %>%
      filter(left_out != "none") %>%
      left_join(
        full_tbl %>% dplyr::select(
          term,
          full_estimate = estimate,
          full_pval     = pval,
          full_ci_lb    = ci_lb,
          full_ci_ub    = ci_ub
        ),
        by = "term"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        delta_from_full = estimate - full_estimate,
        full_sig       = full_pval < 0.05,
        loo_sig        = pval < 0.05,
        direction_flip = sign(estimate) != sign(full_estimate),
        sig_change     = full_sig != loo_sig,
        robustness     = dplyr::case_when(
          direction_flip &  sig_change ~ "Flip + sig. change",
          direction_flip & !sig_change ~ "Direction flip only",
         !direction_flip &  sig_change ~ "Sig. change only",
          TRUE                         ~ "Stable"
        )
      )

    list(full = full_tbl, all = combined_tbl, delta = delta_tbl)
  }

  clean_file_tag_treat <- function(x) {
    x %>%
      tolower() %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
  }

  plot_loo_by_metric_treat <- function(df_in, title_text, subtitle_text) {
    pdat <- df_in %>%
      mutate(
        left_out = forcats::fct_reorder(left_out, abs(delta_from_full)),
        term = stringr::str_remove(term, "^metric")
      )

    ggplot(pdat, aes(x = delta_from_full, y = left_out)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = delta_from_full, y = left_out, yend = left_out), alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_point(aes(color = delta_from_full > 0), size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#B2182B", `FALSE` = "#2166AC"), guide = "none") +
      facet_wrap(~term, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(
        title = title_text,
        subtitle = subtitle_text,
        x = "Delta from full-model estimate",
        y = "Left-out study"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9))
  }

  robustness_levels_treat <- c("Stable", "Sig. change only", "Direction flip only", "Flip + sig. change")
  robustness_colors_treat <- c(
    "Stable"              = "#4DAF4A",
    "Sig. change only"    = "#FF7F00",
    "Direction flip only" = "#984EA3",
    "Flip + sig. change"  = "#E41A1C"
  )

  if (run_loo_models) {
    alpha_treat_stats <- unique(as.character(alpha_es_treat$stats))

    alpha_loo_treat_list <- purrr::map(alpha_treat_stats, function(stat_name) {
      alpha_model_data <- alpha_es_treat %>% filter(stats == stat_name)

      if (nrow(alpha_model_data) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(alpha_model_data$metric) < 2) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      out <- run_leave_one_out_treat(alpha_model_data, model_label = paste0("alpha_treat_", stat_name))
      if (is.null(out)) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      list(
        all = out$all %>% mutate(stats = stat_name, .before = 1),
        delta = out$delta %>% mutate(stats = stat_name, .before = 1)
      )
    })

    alpha_loo_treat_list <- purrr::compact(alpha_loo_treat_list)
    beta_loo_treat <- run_leave_one_out_treat(beta_es_treat, model_label = "beta_treat_lnRR")

    alpha_loo_treat_all <- bind_rows(purrr::map(alpha_loo_treat_list, "all"))
    alpha_loo_treat_delta <- bind_rows(purrr::map(alpha_loo_treat_list, "delta"))
    beta_loo_treat_all <- if (is.null(beta_loo_treat)) tibble() else beta_loo_treat$all
    beta_loo_treat_delta <- if (is.null(beta_loo_treat)) tibble() else beta_loo_treat$delta

    write.csv(alpha_loo_treat_all, here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_treatment_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(alpha_loo_treat_delta, here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_delta_treatment_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_loo_treat_all, here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_treatment_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_loo_treat_delta, here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_delta_treatment_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    alpha_influential_treat <- alpha_loo_treat_delta %>%
      group_by(stats, term) %>%
      slice_max(order_by = abs(delta_from_full), n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup()

    beta_influential_treat <- beta_loo_treat_delta %>%
      group_by(term) %>%
      slice_max(order_by = abs(delta_from_full), n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup()

    alpha_robustness_treat <- alpha_loo_treat_delta %>%
      mutate(
        term       = stringr::str_remove(term, "^metric"),
        robustness = factor(robustness, levels = robustness_levels_treat)
      ) %>%
      count(stats, term, robustness, name = "n_studies") %>%
      tidyr::complete(stats, term, robustness, fill = list(n_studies = 0L))

    beta_robustness_treat <- beta_loo_treat_delta %>%
      mutate(
        term       = stringr::str_remove(term, "^metric"),
        robustness = factor(robustness, levels = robustness_levels_treat)
      ) %>%
      count(term, robustness, name = "n_studies") %>%
      tidyr::complete(term, robustness, fill = list(n_studies = 0L))

    write.csv(alpha_robustness_treat, here("results", "alpha_meta_loo_robustness_treatment_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_robustness_treat, here("results", "beta_meta_loo_robustness_treatment_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(alpha_influential_treat, here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential_treatment_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(beta_influential_treat, here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential_treatment_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    req_loo_treat_files <- c(
      here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_treatment_control.csv"),
      here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_delta_treatment_control.csv"),
      here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_treatment_control.csv"),
      here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_delta_treatment_control.csv"),
      here("results", "alpha_meta_loo_robustness_treatment_control.csv"),
      here("results", "beta_meta_loo_robustness_treatment_control.csv"),
      here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential_treatment_control.csv"),
      here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential_treatment_control.csv")
    )

    missing_loo_treat_files <- req_loo_treat_files[!file.exists(req_loo_treat_files)]
    if (length(missing_loo_treat_files) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Missing Phase C.Treat.1 LOO files: ",
          paste(basename(missing_loo_treat_files), collapse = ", "),
          ". Set run_loo_models <- TRUE once."
        )
      )
    }

    alpha_loo_treat_all <- read.csv(here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_treatment_control.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    alpha_loo_treat_delta <- read.csv(here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_delta_treatment_control.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_loo_treat_all <- read.csv(here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_treatment_control.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_loo_treat_delta <- read.csv(here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_delta_treatment_control.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    alpha_robustness_treat <- read.csv(here("results", "alpha_meta_loo_robustness_treatment_control.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_robustness_treat <- read.csv(here("results", "beta_meta_loo_robustness_treatment_control.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    alpha_influential_treat <- read.csv(here("results", "alpha_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential_treatment_control.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    beta_influential_treat <- read.csv(here("results", "beta_meta_leave_one_out_top_influential_treatment_control.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  if (run_loo_plots) {
    alpha_robustness_treat <- alpha_robustness_treat %>%
      mutate(robustness = factor(robustness, levels = robustness_levels_treat))
    beta_robustness_treat <- beta_robustness_treat %>%
      mutate(robustness = factor(robustness, levels = robustness_levels_treat))

    p_alpha_robustness_treat <- alpha_robustness_treat %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = term, y = n_studies, fill = robustness)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = robustness_colors_treat, name = "LOO outcome") +
      facet_wrap(~stats, ncol = 1) +
      labs(
        title    = "Alpha Diversity (Treatment vs Control) — LOO Robustness",
        subtitle = "Number of studies whose removal changes direction or significance",
        x        = "Metric",
        y        = "Number of studies"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold")
      )

    p_beta_robustness_treat <- beta_robustness_treat %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = term, y = n_studies, fill = robustness)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = robustness_colors_treat, name = "LOO outcome") +
      labs(
        title    = "Beta Diversity (Treatment vs Control, lnRR) — LOO Robustness",
        subtitle = "Number of studies whose removal changes direction or significance",
        x        = "Metric",
        y        = "Number of studies"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

    ggsave(here("results", "meta_loo_robustness_alpha_treatment_control.png"), p_alpha_robustness_treat,
           width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(here("results", "meta_loo_robustness_beta_treatment_control.png"),  p_beta_robustness_treat,
           width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

    alpha_plot_index_treat <- alpha_influential_treat %>%
      group_by(stats) %>%
      group_split() %>%
      purrr::map_dfr(function(dsub) {
        stat_name <- unique(dsub$stats)

        p <- plot_loo_by_metric_treat(
          dsub,
          title_text = paste("Alpha LOO Influence (Treatment vs Control, ", stat_name, ")", sep = ""),
          subtitle_text = paste("Effect size:", stat_name)
        )

        file_name <- paste0("meta_leave_one_out_influence_alpha_treatment_control_", clean_file_tag_treat(stat_name), ".png")
        file_path <- here("results", file_name)
        n_terms <- dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$term)
        ggsave(file_path, p, width = 4 * n_terms, height = 6, dpi = 300)

        tibble(
          domain = "alpha_treatment_control",
          stats = stat_name,
          term = "all_terms",
          plot_file = paste0("results/", file_name)
        )
      })

    beta_plot_index_treat <- tibble()
    if (nrow(beta_influential_treat) > 0) {
      p_beta_loo_treat <- plot_loo_by_metric_treat(
        beta_influential_treat,
        title_text = "Beta LOO Influence (Treatment vs Control, lnRR)",
        subtitle_text = "Effect size: lnRR"
      )
      beta_file_name_treat <- "meta_leave_one_out_influence_beta_lnrr_treatment_control.png"
      beta_file_path_treat <- here("results", beta_file_name_treat)
      beta_n_terms_treat <- dplyr::n_distinct(beta_influential_treat$term)
      ggsave(beta_file_path_treat, p_beta_loo_treat, width = 4 * beta_n_terms_treat, height = 6, dpi = 300)

      beta_plot_index_treat <- tibble(
        domain = "beta_treatment_control",
        stats = "lnRR",
        term = "all_terms",
        plot_file = paste0("results/", beta_file_name_treat)
      )
    }

    loo_plot_index_treat <- bind_rows(alpha_plot_index_treat, beta_plot_index_treat)
    write.csv(loo_plot_index_treat, here("results", "meta_leave_one_out_plot_index_treatment_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    loo_plot_index_treat
  } else {
    message("Phase C.Treat.1 LOO plot generation skipped (run_loo_plots = FALSE).")
  }
}
```

## 8) Phase D — Differential Abundance Analysis (ALDEx2 + ANCOM)

This phase runs DAA within each study/subgroup and then identifies overlap between ALDEx2 and ANCOM signals.

```{r phase-c-daa}
if (run_daa_phase) {
  # Check if ANCOMBC is available
  ancombc_available <- requireNamespace("ANCOMBC", quietly = TRUE)
  
  if (!ancombc_available) {
    cat("⚠️  ANCOMBC package not available. Running ALDEx2 analysis only. ANCOM results will be skipped.\n")
  }

  run_daa_models <- isTRUE(run_daa_models)
  run_daa_plots <- isTRUE(run_daa_plots)

  if (run_daa_models) {
    ancom_call_count <- 0
    ancom_success_count <- 0
    ancom_failure_log <- NULL

    # Only define and use run_ancom_safe if ANCOMBC is available
    if (ancombc_available) {
      run_ancom_safe <- function(data_obj, meta_obj, main_var_name, sample_sums_obj, context_label = "") {
        ancom_call_count <<- ancom_call_count + 1
        
        result <- tryCatch(
          ANCOMBC::ancom(
            data = data_obj,
            meta_data = meta_obj,
            p_adj_method = "BH",
            prv_cut = 0.10,
            lib_cut = min(sample_sums_obj),
            main_var = main_var_name,
            alpha = 0.05,
            n_cl = 1
          ),
          error = function(e) {
            err_msg <- conditionMessage(e)
            ancom_failure_log <<- c(ancom_failure_log, paste0(context_label, ": ", err_msg))
            NULL
          }
        )
        
        if (!is.null(result)) {
          ancom_success_count <<- ancom_success_count + 1
        }
        
        result
      }
    }

    res_all <- list()
    ancom_all <- list()
    res_all_group_within_sex <- list()
    ancom_all_group_within_sex <- list()

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(study_group_map))) {
      study <- study_group_map$Authors[i]
      group_var <- study_group_map$group_var[i]

      sub <- subset_samples(dat33, Authors == study)
      sub <- subset_samples(sub, !(tissue %in% c("skin", "nose", "ear")))

      sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(sub))
      if (!group_var %in% names(sample_df)) next

      sample_df <- normalize_group(sample_df)

      if (!"host_sex" %in% names(sample_df) || length(sample_df$host_sex) == 0) {
        sample_df$host_sex <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(sample_df))
      }
      sample_df$host_sex <- tolower(as.character(sample_df$host_sex))

      if (!"group_general" %in% names(sample_df) || length(sample_df$group_general) == 0) {
        if ("subgroup" %in% names(sample_df) && length(sample_df$subgroup) == nrow(sample_df)) {
          sample_df$group_general <- ifelse(
            grepl("control", as.character(sample_df$subgroup), ignore.case = TRUE),
            "control",
            "treatment"
          )
        } else {
          sample_df$group_general <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(sample_df))
        }
      }
      sample_df$group_general <- tolower(as.character(sample_df$group_general))

      sample_data(sub) <- sample_data(sample_df)

      group_values <- unique(sample_df[[group_var]])

      for (group in group_values) {
        tb <- subset_samples(sub, get(group_var) == group)
        sdf_tb <- data.frame(sample_data(tb))

        valid_group <-
          length(unique(sdf_tb$host_sex)) > 1 &&
          sum(sdf_tb$host_sex == "male") > 1 &&
          sum(sdf_tb$host_sex == "female") > 1

        if (!valid_group) next

        d_x <- aldex.clr(as.data.frame(otu_table(tb)), conds = sample_data(tb)$host_sex, mc.samples = 128)
        d_eff <- aldex.effect(d_x)
        d_tt <- aldex.ttest(d_x)
        res <- data.frame(d_eff, d_tt)
        res$ASV <- rownames(res)
        res <- dplyr::relocate(res, ASV)

        taxa <- as.data.frame(tax_table(tb))
        taxa$ASV <- rownames(taxa)
        taxa <- dplyr::relocate(taxa, ASV)
        res_taxa <- merge(taxa, res, by = "ASV") %>%
          mutate(
            Group = group,
            Study = study,
            direct = case_when(
              effect > 0 ~ "Positive",
              effect <= 0 ~ "Negative",
              TRUE ~ "NA"
            )
          )
        res_all[[paste(study, group, sep = "__")]] <- res_taxa

        rel_abun <- transform_sample_counts(tb, function(x) x / sum(x))
        remove_low_abun <- filter_taxa(rel_abun, function(x) max(x) > 0.001, TRUE)
        tb_f <- filter_taxa(remove_low_abun, function(x) stats::var(x) > 1e-06, TRUE)

        if (ancombc_available) {
          out <- run_ancom_safe(
            data_obj = tb_f,
            meta_obj = sdf_tb,
            main_var_name = "host_sex",
            sample_sums_obj = sample_sums(tb_f),
            context_label = paste(study, group, "sex_contrast", sep = "|")
          )

          if (!is.null(out)) {
            q_val <- out$q_data
            beta_val <- out$beta_data * (q_val < 0.05)
            beta_pos <- apply(abs(beta_val), 2, which.max)
            beta_max <- vapply(seq_along(beta_pos), function(k) beta_val[beta_pos[k], k], FUN.VALUE = double(1))

            n_taxa <- ifelse(
              is.null(out$zero_ind),
              nrow(otu_table(tb_f)),
              sum(apply(out$zero_ind[, -1, drop = FALSE], 1, sum) == 0)
            )

            df_w <- out$res %>%
              mutate(
                beta = beta_max,
                direct = case_when(
                  detected_0.7 & beta > 0 ~ "Positive",
                  detected_0.7 & beta <= 0 ~ "Negative",
                  TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
                )
              ) %>%
              arrange(W)
            df_w$ASV <- rownames(df_w)
            df_w <- dplyr::relocate(df_w, ASV)

            df_w_taxa <- merge(taxa, df_w, by = "ASV") %>%
              mutate(group = group, Study = study)
            df_w_taxa$W <- replace(df_w_taxa$W, is.infinite(df_w_taxa$W), n_taxa - 1)

            ancom_all[[paste(study, group, sep = "__")]] <- df_w_taxa
          }
        }
      }

      # Additional contrast: treatment vs control within each sex (within study)
      for (sex_value in c("female", "male")) {
        tb_sex <- subset_samples(sub, host_sex == sex_value)
        sdf_sex <- data.frame(sample_data(tb_sex))
        if (nrow(sdf_sex) < 4 || !"group_general" %in% names(sdf_sex)) next

        sdf_sex$group_general <- tolower(as.character(sdf_sex$group_general))
        valid_group <-
          sum(sdf_sex$group_general == "control", na.rm = TRUE) > 1 &&
          sum(sdf_sex$group_general == "treatment", na.rm = TRUE) > 1
        if (!valid_group) next

        keep_samples <- rownames(sdf_sex)[sdf_sex$group_general %in% c("control", "treatment")]
        if (length(keep_samples) < 4) next

        tb_sex <- prune_samples(keep_samples, tb_sex)
        sdf_sex <- data.frame(sample_data(tb_sex))
        sdf_sex$group_general <- factor(tolower(as.character(sdf_sex$group_general)), levels = c("control", "treatment"))
        if (any(is.na(sdf_sex$group_general))) next

        d_x_group <- aldex.clr(as.data.frame(otu_table(tb_sex)), conds = sample_data(tb_sex)$group_general, mc.samples = 128)
        d_eff_group <- aldex.effect(d_x_group)
        d_tt_group <- aldex.ttest(d_x_group)
        res_group <- data.frame(d_eff_group, d_tt_group)
        res_group$ASV <- rownames(res_group)
        res_group <- dplyr::relocate(res_group, ASV)

        taxa_group <- as.data.frame(tax_table(tb_sex))
        taxa_group$ASV <- rownames(taxa_group)
        taxa_group <- dplyr::relocate(taxa_group, ASV)
        res_taxa_group <- merge(taxa_group, res_group, by = "ASV") %>%
          mutate(
            Sex = sex_value,
            Study = study,
            Contrast = "group_general_within_sex",
            direct = case_when(
              effect > 0 ~ "Positive",
              effect <= 0 ~ "Negative",
              TRUE ~ "NA"
            )
          )
        res_all_group_within_sex[[paste(study, sex_value, sep = "__")]] <- res_taxa_group

        rel_abun_group <- transform_sample_counts(tb_sex, function(x) x / sum(x))
        remove_low_abun_group <- filter_taxa(rel_abun_group, function(x) max(x) > 0.001, TRUE)
        tb_f_group <- filter_taxa(remove_low_abun_group, function(x) stats::var(x) > 1e-06, TRUE)
        if (ntaxa(tb_f_group) < 2) next

        if (ancombc_available) {
          out_group <- run_ancom_safe(
            data_obj = tb_f_group,
            meta_obj = sdf_sex,
            main_var_name = "group_general",
            sample_sums_obj = sample_sums(tb_f_group),
            context_label = paste(study, sex_value, "group_contrast", sep = "|")
          )

          if (!is.null(out_group)) {
            q_val_group <- out_group$q_data
            beta_val_group <- out_group$beta_data * (q_val_group < 0.05)
            beta_pos_group <- apply(abs(beta_val_group), 2, which.max)
            beta_max_group <- vapply(seq_along(beta_pos_group), function(k) beta_val_group[beta_pos_group[k], k], FUN.VALUE = double(1))

            n_taxa_group <- ifelse(
              is.null(out_group$zero_ind),
              nrow(otu_table(tb_f_group)),
              sum(apply(out_group$zero_ind[, -1, drop = FALSE], 1, sum) == 0)
            )

            df_w_group <- out_group$res %>%
              mutate(
                beta = beta_max_group,
                direct = case_when(
                  detected_0.7 & beta > 0 ~ "Positive",
                  detected_0.7 & beta <= 0 ~ "Negative",
                  TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
                )
              ) %>%
              arrange(W)
            df_w_group$ASV <- rownames(df_w_group)
            df_w_group <- dplyr::relocate(df_w_group, ASV)

            df_w_taxa_group <- merge(taxa_group, df_w_group, by = "ASV") %>%
              mutate(Sex = sex_value, Study = study, Contrast = "group_general_within_sex")
            df_w_taxa_group$W <- replace(df_w_taxa_group$W, is.infinite(df_w_taxa_group$W), n_taxa_group - 1)

            ancom_all_group_within_sex[[paste(study, sex_value, sep = "__")]] <- df_w_taxa_group
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (ancombc_available) {
      cat(
        "\n=== ANCOM Diagnostic Report ===\n",
        "Total ANCOM calls attempted: ", ancom_call_count, "\n",
        "Successful ANCOM calls: ", ancom_success_count, "\n",
        "Failed ANCOM calls: ", ancom_call_count - ancom_success_count, "\n"
      )

      if (ancom_call_count > 0 && ancom_success_count == 0) {
        cat("\n⚠️  WARNING: All ANCOM calls failed. Root cause likely: ANCOMBC/CVXR version incompatibility.\n")
        cat("   Your CVXR version does not export 'solve', which newer ANCOMBC versions require.\n")
        cat("   See errors below (if any):\n\n")
      }

      if (length(ancom_failure_log) > 0) {
        cat("--- ANCOM Error Log ---\n")
        cat(paste(head(ancom_failure_log, 10), collapse = "\n\n"))
        cat("\n\n--- RECOMMENDED FIX ---\n")
        cat("Option 1: Update CVXR to a version that exports solve, OR\n")
        cat("Option 2: Update ANCOMBC to a newer version compatible with current CVXR, OR\n")
        cat("Option 3: Downgrade CVXR to a version that exports solve.\n\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("\n⚠️  ANCOMBC was not available, so ANCOM analysis was skipped.\n")
      cat("   Only ALDEx2 results will be saved.\n\n")
    }

    res.all <- bind_rows(res_all)
    res.all.sig <- res.all %>% 
      filter(wi.eBH < 0.05, abs(effect) >= aldex_effect_size_threshold)

    ancom.all <- bind_rows(ancom_all)
    if (nrow(ancom.all) == 0) {
      ancom.all <- tibble(ASV = character(), group = character(), Study = character(), direct = character())
    }
```
