```{r phase-c-daa}
    ancom.all.sig <- ancom.all %>% filter(direct %in% c("Positive", "Negative"))

    res.all.group_within_sex <- bind_rows(res_all_group_within_sex)
    res.all.group_within_sex.sig <- res.all.group_within_sex %>% 
      filter(wi.eBH < 0.05, abs(effect) >= aldex_effect_size_threshold)

    if (ancombc_available) {
      ancom.all <- bind_rows(ancom_all)
      if (nrow(ancom.all) == 0) {
        ancom.all <- tibble(ASV = character(), group = character(), Study = character(), direct = character())
      }
      ancom.all.sig <- ancom.all %>% filter(direct %in% c("Positive", "Negative"))

      ancom.all.group_within_sex <- bind_rows(ancom_all_group_within_sex)
      if (nrow(ancom.all.group_within_sex) == 0) {
        ancom.all.group_within_sex <- tibble(ASV = character(), Sex = character(), Study = character(), Contrast = character(), direct = character())
      }
      ancom.all.group_within_sex.sig <- ancom.all.group_within_sex %>% filter(direct %in% c("Positive", "Negative"))
    }

    write.csv(res.all, here("results", "res.all.combined.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(res.all.sig, here("results", "res.all.combined.sig.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(res.all.group_within_sex, here("results", "res.all.combined.group_within_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(res.all.group_within_sex.sig, here("results", "res.all.combined.sig.group_within_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    if (ancombc_available) {
      write.csv(ancom.all, here("results", "ancom.all.combined_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
      write.csv(ancom.all.sig, here("results", "ancom.all.combined.sig_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
      write.csv(ancom.all.group_within_sex, here("results", "ancom.all.combined.group_within_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
      write.csv(ancom.all.group_within_sex.sig, here("results", "ancom.all.combined.sig.group_within_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }

    if (ancombc_available && nrow(res.all.sig) > 0 && nrow(ancom.all.sig) > 0) {
      res.all.sig <- res.all.sig %>% mutate(id = paste(Group, Study, direct, sep = "_"))
      ancom.all.sig <- ancom.all.sig %>% mutate(id = paste(group, Study, direct, sep = "_"))

      common_ids <- intersect(res.all.sig$id, ancom.all.sig$id)
      overlap_a <- res.all.sig %>% filter(id %in% common_ids) %>% pull(Row.names)
      overlap_b <- ancom.all.sig %>% filter(id %in% common_ids) %>% pull(Row.names)

      both.sig <- res.all.sig %>% filter(Row.names %in% intersect(overlap_a, overlap_b))
      write.csv(both.sig, here("results", "both.sig_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }

    if (ancombc_available && nrow(res.all.group_within_sex.sig) > 0 && nrow(ancom.all.group_within_sex.sig) > 0) {
      res.gws <- res.all.group_within_sex.sig %>% mutate(id = paste(Sex, Study, direct, sep = "_"))
      ancom.gws <- ancom.all.group_within_sex.sig %>% mutate(id = paste(Sex, Study, direct, sep = "_"))

      common_ids_gws <- intersect(res.gws$id, ancom.gws$id)
      overlap_a_gws <- res.gws %>% filter(id %in% common_ids_gws) %>% pull(Row.names)
      overlap_b_gws <- ancom.gws %>% filter(id %in% common_ids_gws) %>% pull(Row.names)

      both.sig.gws <- res.gws %>% filter(Row.names %in% intersect(overlap_a_gws, overlap_b_gws))
      write.csv(both.sig.gws, here("results", "both.sig_group_within_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }

    # Build daa_sig_counts with ALDEx2 and optionally ANCOM if available
    daa_sig_counts_list <- list(
      res.all.sig %>% mutate(method = "ALDEx2", contrast = "sex_within_subgroup") %>% dplyr::select(method, contrast, Study),
      res.all.group_within_sex.sig %>% mutate(method = "ALDEx2", contrast = "group_general_within_sex") %>% dplyr::select(method, contrast, Study)
    )

    if (ancombc_available) {
      daa_sig_counts_list <- c(
        daa_sig_counts_list,
        list(
          ancom.all.sig %>% mutate(method = "ANCOM", contrast = "sex_within_subgroup") %>% dplyr::select(method, contrast, Study),
          ancom.all.group_within_sex.sig %>% mutate(method = "ANCOM", contrast = "group_general_within_sex") %>% dplyr::select(method, contrast, Study)
        )
      )
    }

    daa_sig_counts <- bind_rows(daa_sig_counts_list) %>%
      count(method, contrast, Study, name = "n_sig")

    write.csv(daa_sig_counts, here("results", "daa_significant_counts_by_study.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    daa_counts_file <- here("results", "daa_significant_counts_by_study.csv")
    if (!file.exists(daa_counts_file)) {
      stop("Missing results/daa_significant_counts_by_study.csv. Set run_daa_models <- TRUE once.")
    }
    daa_sig_counts <- read.csv(daa_counts_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (!"contrast" %in% names(daa_sig_counts)) {
      daa_sig_counts$contrast <- "sex_within_subgroup"
    }
  }

  if (run_daa_plots) {
    p_daa_sig_counts <- daa_sig_counts %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Study, n_sig), y = n_sig, fill = method)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge") +
      facet_wrap(~contrast, ncol = 1) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(
        title = "Significant Taxa Counts by Study, Method, and Contrast",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Number of significant taxa",
        fill = "Method"
      ) +
      theme_bw()

    ggsave(here("results", "daa_significant_counts_by_study.png"), p_daa_sig_counts, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

    # ========== Additional visualizations for ALDEx2 results ==========
    
    # Helper function to create volcano plots for each contrast
    plot_aldex_volcano <- function(data_sig, title_text, subtitle_text) {
      data_sig <- data_sig %>%
        mutate(
          taxa_label = paste0(Genus, " (", Family, ")"),
          taxa_label = ifelse(is.na(Genus), Species, taxa_label)
        )
      
      ggplot(data_sig, aes(x = effect, y = -log10(wi.eBH))) +
        geom_point(aes(color = direct), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(-aldex_effect_size_threshold, aldex_effect_size_threshold), 
                   linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", alpha = 0.5) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", alpha = 0.5) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c(Positive = "#B2182B", Negative = "#2166AC", `NA` = "grey70"), name = "Direction") +
        labs(
          title = title_text,
          subtitle = subtitle_text,
          x = "Effect size (log scale)",
          y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)"
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
        theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40"))
    }
    
    # Plot 1: Sex contrast (male vs female within control/treatment)
    if (nrow(res.all.sig) > 0) {
      p_sex_volcano <- plot_aldex_volcano(
        res.all.sig,
        title = "Sex Contrast: Differential Abundance (Male vs. Female)",
        subtitle = paste0("Effect size threshold: |effect| >= ", aldex_effect_size_threshold, "; adjusted p < 0.05")
      )
      ggsave(here("results", "aldex_volcano_sex_contrast.png"), p_sex_volcano, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
      
      # Summary table by study+direction
      sex_summary <- res.all.sig %>%
        group_by(Study, direct) %>%
        summarise(n_taxa = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = direct, values_from = n_taxa, values_fill = 0)
      
      write.csv(sex_summary, here("results", "aldex_sex_contrast_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Plot 2: Group contrast (control vs treatment within sex)
    if (nrow(res.all.group_within_sex.sig) > 0) {
      p_group_volcano <- plot_aldex_volcano(
        res.all.group_within_sex.sig,
        title = "Group Contrast: Differential Abundance (Control vs. Treatment)",
        subtitle = paste0("Effect size threshold: |effect| >= ", aldex_effect_size_threshold, "; adjusted p < 0.05")
      )
      ggsave(here("results", "aldex_volcano_group_contrast.png"), p_group_volcano, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
      
      # Summary by study+sex+direction
      group_summary <- res.all.group_within_sex.sig %>%
        group_by(Study, Sex, direct) %>%
        summarise(n_taxa = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = direct, values_from = n_taxa, values_fill = 0)
      
      write.csv(group_summary, here("results", "aldex_group_contrast_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Plot 3: Forest-plot style visualization of top differential taxa across studies
    if (nrow(res.all.sig) > 0) {
      # Get top taxa by effect size
      top_taxa_sex <- res.all.sig %>%
        group_by(ASV) %>%
        slice_max(abs(effect), n = 1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        slice_max(abs(effect), n = 12)
      
      if (nrow(top_taxa_sex) > 0) {
        forest_data <- res.all.sig %>%
          filter(ASV %in% top_taxa_sex$ASV) %>%
          mutate(
            taxa_label = paste0(Genus, " (", Family, ")")
          ) %>%
          arrange(effect)
        
        p_forest_sex <- forest_data %>%
          ggplot(aes(x = effect, y = reorder(paste(taxa_label, Study, sep = " | "), effect))) +
          geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
          geom_point(aes(color = direct, size = -log10(wi.eBH)), alpha = 0.7) +
          geom_errorbarh(
            aes(xmin = effect - 0.5, xmax = effect + 0.5, color = direct),
            height = 0.3, alpha = 0.4
          ) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c(Positive = "#B2182B", Negative = "#2166AC", `NA` = "grey70")) +
          scale_size(name = "-log10(p-adj)", range = c(1, 5)) +
          labs(
            title = "Top Differential Abundance Taxa: Sex Contrast",
            subtitle = "Points sized by adjusted p-value significance",
            x = "Effect size (log scale)",
            y = NULL
          ) +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
        
        ggsave(here("results", "aldex_forest_sex_contrast.png"), p_forest_sex, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
      }
    }
    
    # Plot 4: Forest-plot for group contrast
    if (nrow(res.all.group_within_sex.sig) > 0) {
      top_taxa_group <- res.all.group_within_sex.sig %>%
        group_by(ASV) %>%
        slice_max(abs(effect), n = 1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        slice_max(abs(effect), n = 12)
      
      if (nrow(top_taxa_group) > 0) {
        forest_data_group <- res.all.group_within_sex.sig %>%
          filter(ASV %in% top_taxa_group$ASV) %>%
          mutate(
            taxa_label = paste0(Genus, " (", Family, ")")
          ) %>%
          arrange(effect)
        
        p_forest_group <- forest_data_group %>%
          ggplot(aes(x = effect, y = reorder(paste(taxa_label, Study, Sex, sep = " | "), effect))) +
          geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
          geom_point(aes(color = direct, size = -log10(wi.eBH)), alpha = 0.7) +
          geom_errorbarh(
            aes(xmin = effect - 0.5, xmax = effect + 0.5, color = direct),
            height = 0.3, alpha = 0.4
          ) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c(Positive = "#B2182B", Negative = "#2166AC", `NA` = "grey70")) +
          scale_size(name = "-log10(p-adj)", range = c(1, 5)) +
          labs(
            title = "Top Differential Abundance Taxa: Group Contrast (Control vs Treatment)",
            subtitle = "Points sized by adjusted p-value significance; faceted by sex",
            x = "Effect size (log scale)",
            y = NULL
          ) +
          facet_wrap(~Sex) +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
        
        ggsave(here("results", "aldex_forest_group_contrast.png"), p_forest_group, width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300)
      }
    }

    p_daa_sig_counts
  } else {
    message("Phase D DAA plot generation skipped (run_daa_plots = FALSE).")
  }
}
```

### Phase D.1 — How Taxa Abundance Explains Alpha Diversity

This section fits per-taxon association models of the form `diversity ~ abundance`
for alpha diversity only, and tests whether the relationship changes by sex and treatment/subgroup using interaction terms.

```{r phase-d1-diversity-vs-taxa}
# Phase D.1: test one or multiple taxa cutoffs (e.g., c(25, 100, 200))
#top_n_taxa_set <- c(25, 100)
run_d1_models <- FALSE ##not rerun the whole analysis
run_d1_plots <- TRUE ##for revise plots

if (run_daa_phase) {
  # Allow this chunk to run standalone in a fresh session
  if (!exists("normalize_group")) {
    normalize_group <- function(df) {
      df %>%
        mutate(
          subgroup = case_when(
            is.na(experimental_treatment_raw) ~ NA_character_,
            experimental_treatment_raw == "Water-T0" ~ "control",
            Authors == "Velasco et al. 2021" & strain == "C57BL/6J" ~ "control",
            TRUE ~ experimental_treatment_raw
          ),
          group_general = case_when(
            is.na(subgroup) ~ NA_character_,
            grepl("control", subgroup, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "control",
            TRUE ~ "treatment"
          )
        )
    }
  }

  required_objs <- c("study_group_map", "dat33", "dat_alpha")
  missing_objs <- required_objs[!vapply(required_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing_objs) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Missing required object(s): ", paste(missing_objs, collapse = ", "),
        ". Run Sections 3-5 before Phase D.1."
      )
    )
  }

  top_n_taxa_set <- sort(unique(as.integer(top_n_taxa_set[top_n_taxa_set > 0])))
  if (length(top_n_taxa_set) == 0) {
    stop("top_n_taxa_set must contain at least one positive integer.")
  }

  run_d1_models <- isTRUE(run_d1_models)
  run_d1_plots <- isTRUE(run_d1_plots)
  top_k_interaction_taxa <- 5

  if (run_d1_models) {

  # ----- Sample annotation with harmonized subgroup/treatment labels -----
  meta_all <- data.frame(sample_data(dat33)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID")

  sample_annot <- purrr::map2_dfr(study_group_map$Authors, study_group_map$group_var, function(study, group_var) {
    meta_sub <- meta_all %>% filter(Authors == study)
    if (nrow(meta_sub) == 0) return(tibble())

    meta_sub <- normalize_group(meta_sub)
    subgroup_val <- if (group_var %in% names(meta_sub)) as.character(meta_sub[[group_var]]) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_sub))
    if (length(subgroup_val) == 1) subgroup_val <- rep(subgroup_val, nrow(meta_sub))
    if (length(subgroup_val) == 0) subgroup_val <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_sub))

    group_general_val <- if ("group_general" %in% names(meta_sub)) as.character(meta_sub$group_general) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_sub))
    if (length(group_general_val) == 1) group_general_val <- rep(group_general_val, nrow(meta_sub))
    if (length(group_general_val) == 0) group_general_val <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_sub))

    host_sex_val <- if ("host_sex" %in% names(meta_sub)) tolower(as.character(meta_sub$host_sex)) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_sub))
    if (length(host_sex_val) == 1) host_sex_val <- rep(host_sex_val, nrow(meta_sub))
    if (length(host_sex_val) == 0) host_sex_val <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_sub))

    tissue_val <- if ("tissue" %in% names(meta_sub)) as.character(meta_sub$tissue) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_sub))
    if (length(tissue_val) == 1) tissue_val <- rep(tissue_val, nrow(meta_sub))
    if (length(tissue_val) == 0) tissue_val <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_sub))

    tibble(
      SampleID = meta_sub$SampleID,
      Authors = meta_sub$Authors,
      host_sex = host_sex_val,
      subgroup = subgroup_val,
      group_general = group_general_val,
      tissue = tissue_val
    )
  }) %>%
    filter(!tissue %in% c("skin", "nose", "ear")) %>%
    mutate(
      group_general = ifelse(is.na(group_general) | group_general == "", "unknown", group_general)
    )

  # ----- Taxa abundance matrix (relative abundance, top taxa) -----
  otu_mat <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(dat33), "matrix")
  if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(dat33)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
  otu_mat <- otu_mat[, colnames(otu_mat) %in% sample_annot$SampleID, drop = FALSE]

  sample_sums_vec <- colSums(otu_mat)
  sample_sums_vec[sample_sums_vec == 0] <- NA_real_
  otu_rel <- sweep(otu_mat, 2, sample_sums_vec, "/")

  tax_mean <- rowMeans(otu_rel, na.rm = TRUE)

  tax_df <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(dat33)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("TaxonID")

  clean_tax_rank <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x[x %in% c("", "NA", "Unknown", "unknown", "uncultured", "Unassigned", "unclassified", "g__", "s__")] <- NA
    x
  }

  rank_cols <- intersect(c("Species", "Genus", "Family", "Order", "Class", "Phylum", "Kingdom"), names(tax_df))
  if (all(c("Genus", "Species") %in% names(tax_df))) {
    tax_df <- tax_df %>%
      mutate(
        Genus_clean = clean_tax_rank(Genus),
        Species_clean = clean_tax_rank(Species),
        taxon_core = case_when(
          !is.na(Genus_clean) & !is.na(Species_clean) ~ paste(Genus_clean, Species_clean),
          !is.na(Genus_clean) ~ Genus_clean,
          !is.na(Species_clean) ~ Species_clean,
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      )
  } else if (length(rank_cols) == 0) {
    tax_df$taxon_core <- NA_character_
  } else {
    tax_df$taxon_core <- apply(tax_df[, rank_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) {
      vals <- clean_tax_rank(x)
      first_non_na <- vals[which(!is.na(vals))[1]]
      ifelse(is.na(first_non_na), NA_character_, first_non_na)
    })
  }
  tax_df$taxon_core <- dplyr::coalesce(tax_df$taxon_core, "Unclassified taxon")

  # ----- Alpha diversity outcomes (use existing dat_alpha from Phase A) -----
  alpha_df <- dat_alpha %>%
    mutate(SampleID = rownames(dat_alpha)) %>%
    left_join(sample_annot, by = c("SampleID", "Authors", "subgroup", "group_general", "tissue")) %>%
    mutate(
      host_sex = dplyr::coalesce(tolower(as.character(Sex)), host_sex)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(host_sex), host_sex %in% c("male", "female")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Observed, Chao1, Shannon, Simpson, PD, Evenness),
      names_to = "metric",
      values_to = "outcome"
    )

  # ----- Modeling helper -----
  fit_div_abd_models <- function(df_in, taxa_abund_long_in) {
    merged <- df_in %>%
      left_join(taxa_abund_long_in %>% dplyr::select(SampleID, TaxonID, taxon_label, abundance), by = "SampleID") %>%
      filter(
        is.finite(outcome),
        is.finite(abundance),
        !is.na(TaxonID),
        !is.na(metric),
        !is.na(host_sex),
        !is.na(group_general),
        !is.na(Authors)
      )

    model_tbl <- merged %>%
      group_by(metric, TaxonID) %>%
      group_split() %>%
      purrr::map_dfr(function(dsub) {
        if (nrow(dsub) < 20) return(tibble())
        if (sd(dsub$abundance, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(tibble())
        if (dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$host_sex) < 2) return(tibble())
        if (dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$group_general) < 2) return(tibble())

        dsub <- dsub %>%
          mutate(
            host_sex = factor(host_sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
            group_general = factor(group_general),
            Authors = factor(Authors)
          )

        # Preferred: random intercept for study/source (Authors)
        fit_lmer <- tryCatch(
          lmerTest::lmer(
            outcome ~ abundance * host_sex + abundance * group_general + (1 | Authors),
            data = dsub,
            REML = FALSE
          ),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )

        use_lm_fallback <- is.null(fit_lmer) || lme4::isSingular(fit_lmer, tol = 1e-4)
        fit_engine <- ifelse(use_lm_fallback, "lm_fallback", "lmer_random_authors")

        fit_final <- if (use_lm_fallback) {
          tryCatch(
            lm(outcome ~ abundance * host_sex + abundance * group_general + Authors, data = dsub),
            error = function(e) NULL
          )
        } else {
          fit_lmer
        }

        if (is.null(fit_final)) return(tibble())

        coef_tbl <- as.data.frame(summary(fit_final)$coefficients) %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
          as_tibble()

        if (!("Pr(>|t|)" %in% names(coef_tbl))) {
          coef_tbl$`Pr(>|t|)` <- NA_real_
        }

        coef_tbl <- coef_tbl %>%
          transmute(
            term,
            estimate = Estimate,
            se = `Std. Error`,
            t = `t value`,
            pval = `Pr(>|t|)`
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            term_type = case_when(
              term == "abundance" ~ "main_abundance",
              stringr::str_detect(term, "^abundance:host_sex") ~ "sex_interaction",
              stringr::str_detect(term, "^abundance:group_general") ~ "treatment_interaction",
              TRUE ~ "other"
            )
          ) %>%
          filter(term_type != "other") %>%
          mutate(
            metric = dsub$metric[[1]],
            TaxonID = dsub$TaxonID[[1]],
            taxon_label = dsub$taxon_label[[1]],
            n = nrow(dsub),
            n_studies = dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$Authors),
            fit_engine = fit_engine
          )

        coef_tbl
      }) %>%
      group_by(metric, term_type) %>%
      mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
      ungroup()

    model_tbl
  }

  # ----- Run model for each taxa cutoff (top 25 and top 100) -----

  d1_res_by_cutoff <- purrr::map(top_n_taxa_set, function(top_n_taxa) {
    taxa_keep <- names(sort(tax_mean, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(top_n_taxa, length(tax_mean)))]

    taxa_abund_long <- otu_rel[taxa_keep, , drop = FALSE] %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("TaxonID") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-TaxonID, names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "abundance") %>%
      left_join(
        tax_df %>%
          mutate(taxon_label = taxon_core) %>%
          dplyr::select(TaxonID, taxon_label),
        by = "TaxonID"
      )

    taxa_div_models_n <- fit_div_abd_models(alpha_df, taxa_abund_long) %>%
      mutate(top_n_taxa = top_n_taxa, .before = 1)

    taxa_div_sig_summary_n <- taxa_div_models_n %>%
      mutate(sig = padj < 0.05) %>%
      group_by(top_n_taxa, metric, term_type) %>%
      summarise(
        n_sig_taxa = sum(sig, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_tested_taxa = n_distinct(TaxonID),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    top_interaction_taxa_n <- taxa_div_models_n %>%
      filter(term_type %in% c("sex_interaction", "treatment_interaction")) %>%
      mutate(
        interaction_type = recode(
          term_type,
          sex_interaction = "Sex interaction",
          treatment_interaction = "Treatment interaction"
        ),
        score = abs(t),
        effect_signed = dplyr::if_else(is.finite(t), t, estimate),
        direction = dplyr::if_else(effect_signed >= 0, "Positive", "Negative")
      ) %>%
      group_by(top_n_taxa, metric, interaction_type) %>%
      arrange(desc(score), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_k_interaction_taxa) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        sig_label = case_when(
          padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
          padj < 0.01 ~ "**",
          padj < 0.05 ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        taxon_plot = ifelse(
          nchar(taxon_label) > 45,
          paste0(substr(taxon_label, 1, 45), "..."),
          taxon_label
        )
      )

    list(
      models = taxa_div_models_n,
      summary = taxa_div_sig_summary_n,
      top_interaction = top_interaction_taxa_n
    )
  })

  taxa_div_models_all <- bind_rows(purrr::map(d1_res_by_cutoff, "models"))
  taxa_div_sig_summary <- bind_rows(purrr::map(d1_res_by_cutoff, "summary"))
  top_interaction_taxa <- bind_rows(purrr::map(d1_res_by_cutoff, "top_interaction"))

  write.csv(taxa_div_models_all, here("results", "taxa_diversity_association_models.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(taxa_div_sig_summary, here("results", "taxa_diversity_association_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(top_interaction_taxa, here("results", "taxa_diversity_top_interaction_taxa.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  fallback_summary <- taxa_div_models_all %>%
    group_by(top_n_taxa, metric) %>%
    summarise(
      n_terms = n(),
      n_lmer = sum(fit_engine == "lmer_random_authors", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_lm_fallback = sum(fit_engine == "lm_fallback", na.rm = TRUE),
      fallback_rate = ifelse(n_terms > 0, n_lm_fallback / n_terms, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  write.csv(fallback_summary, here("results", "taxa_diversity_fit_fallback_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  # Also write explicit per-cutoff files for supplement export
  purrr::walk(top_n_taxa_set, function(top_n) {
    write.csv(
      taxa_div_models_all %>% filter(top_n_taxa == top_n),
      here("results", paste0("taxa_diversity_association_models_top", top_n, ".csv")),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    write.csv(
      taxa_div_sig_summary %>% filter(top_n_taxa == top_n),
      here("results", paste0("taxa_diversity_association_summary_top", top_n, ".csv")),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    write.csv(
      top_interaction_taxa %>% filter(top_n_taxa == top_n),
      here("results", paste0("taxa_diversity_top_interaction_taxa_top", top_n, ".csv")),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  })

  } else {
    required_plot_inputs <- c(
      here("results", "taxa_diversity_association_summary.csv"),
      here("results", "taxa_diversity_top_interaction_taxa.csv")
    )
    missing_plot_inputs <- required_plot_inputs[!file.exists(required_plot_inputs)]
    if (length(missing_plot_inputs) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "D.1 plotting-only mode needs existing CSV outputs, but missing: ",
          paste(basename(missing_plot_inputs), collapse = ", "),
          ". Run once with run_d1_models = TRUE first."
        )
      )
    }

    taxa_div_sig_summary <- read.csv(here("results", "taxa_diversity_association_summary.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    top_interaction_taxa <- read.csv(here("results", "taxa_diversity_top_interaction_taxa.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  if (!"effect_signed" %in% names(top_interaction_taxa)) {
    if ("t" %in% names(top_interaction_taxa)) {
      top_interaction_taxa$effect_signed <- ifelse(
        is.finite(top_interaction_taxa$t),
        top_interaction_taxa$t,
        top_interaction_taxa$estimate
      )
    } else {
      top_interaction_taxa$effect_signed <- top_interaction_taxa$estimate
    }
  }
  if (!"direction" %in% names(top_interaction_taxa)) {
    top_interaction_taxa$direction <- ifelse(top_interaction_taxa$effect_signed >= 0, "Positive", "Negative")
  }

  if (run_d1_plots) {

  plot_top_interactions <- function(df_in, title_txt, subtitle_txt, caption_txt = NULL) {
    if (nrow(df_in) == 0) {
      return(
        ggplot() +
          geom_blank() +
          labs(title = title_txt, subtitle = "No interaction terms available") +
          theme_void()
      )
    }

    df_plot <- df_in %>%
      mutate(
        metric = factor(metric, levels = unique(metric)),
        taxon_plot = reorder(taxon_plot, abs(effect_signed)),
        direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Negative", "Positive"))
      )

    ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = effect_signed, y = taxon_plot, fill = direction)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
      geom_col(width = 0.75) +
      geom_text(
        aes(
          label = sig_label,
          hjust = ifelse(effect_signed >= 0, -0.2, 1.2)
        ),
        size = 3
      ) +
      facet_grid(metric ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#2166AC", "Positive" = "#B2182B")) +
      labs(
        title = title_txt,
        subtitle = subtitle_txt,
        x = "Signed association (t value; + positive, - negative)",
        y = "Taxon",
        fill = "Direction",
        caption = caption_txt
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8, color = "grey30")
      )
  }

  interaction_name_to_file <- c(
    "Sex interaction" = "sex",
    "Treatment interaction" = "treatment"
  )

  top_interaction_plot_index <- top_interaction_taxa %>%
    distinct(top_n_taxa, interaction_type) %>%
    arrange(top_n_taxa, interaction_type) %>%
    purrr::pmap_dfr(function(top_n_taxa, interaction_type) {
      dsub <- top_interaction_taxa %>%
        filter(top_n_taxa == !!top_n_taxa, interaction_type == !!interaction_type)

      interaction_file_tag <- interaction_name_to_file[[interaction_type]]
      file_name <- paste0("taxa_diversity_top_interaction_alpha_top", top_n_taxa, "_", interaction_file_tag, ".png")

      p <- plot_top_interactions(
        dsub,
        title_txt = paste0("Top ", interaction_type, " Taxa Explaining Alpha Diversity"),
        subtitle_txt = paste0("top_n_taxa = ", top_n_taxa, "; top ", top_k_interaction_taxa, " taxa per metric by |t| (bar direction shows sign)"),
        caption_txt = ifelse(
          interaction_type == "Sex interaction",
          "Sex interaction uses female as reference: >0 means abundance-diversity slope is more positive in males than females; <0 means more positive in females than males.",
          "Treatment interaction: >0 indicates a more positive abundance-diversity slope in treatment than control; <0 indicates more positive in control than treatment."
        )
      )

      h <- max(6, 2.2 * dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$metric))
      ggsave(here("results", file_name), p, width = 10, height = h, dpi = 300)

      tibble(
        top_n_taxa = top_n_taxa,
        interaction_type = interaction_type,
        plot_file = paste0("results/", file_name)
      )
    })

  write.csv(top_interaction_plot_index, here("results", "taxa_diversity_top_interaction_plot_index.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  p_taxa_div_sig <- taxa_div_sig_summary %>%
    mutate(term_type = factor(term_type, levels = c("main_abundance", "sex_interaction", "treatment_interaction"))) %>%
    mutate(top_n_taxa = factor(top_n_taxa, levels = sort(unique(top_n_taxa)))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = metric, y = n_sig_taxa, fill = term_type)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    facet_wrap(~top_n_taxa, ncol = 1) +
    labs(
      title = "How Taxa Abundance Explains Alpha Diversity",
      subtitle = "Significant taxa-association terms (BH-adjusted p < 0.05) for top 25 and top 100 taxa",
      x = "Diversity metric",
      y = "Number of significant taxa",
      fill = "Model term"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

  ggsave(here("results", "taxa_diversity_association_summary.png"), p_taxa_div_sig, width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300)

  p_taxa_div_sig
  } else {
    message("Phase D.1 plots skipped (run_d1_plots = FALSE).")
  }
}
```
